Fire for purification of oneself, and Śrīviṣṇu for liberation,

3.32.s:
jñānāya śaṅkaraṃ durgāṃ paramaiśva ryyahetave ..
sampūjane phalamidaṃ viparītamapūjane ..25..
3.32.d:
ज्ञानाय शङ्करं दुर्गां परमैश्व र्य्यहेतवे ॥
सम्पूजने फलमिदं विपरीतमपूजने ॥25॥
3.32.m:
Śaṅkara for knowledge, and Durgā for supreme sovereignty.
This is the fruit in worshipping them; the opposite occurs in not worshipping them.

3.32.s:
tataḥ kṛtvā parīhāramiṣṭadevaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ ..
stotraṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ paṭhedbhaktyā ca tacchṛṇu..26..
3.32.d:
ततः कृत्वा परीहारमिष्टदेवं च भक्तितः ॥
स्तोत्रं च सामवेदोक्तं पठेद्भक्त्या च तच्छृणु॥26॥
3.32.m:
Then, having performed circumambulation with devotion to the chosen deity,
one should recite with devotion the hymn of praise spoken in the Sāmaveda; hear that.

3.32.s:
mahādeva uvāca ..
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam..
nirliptaṃ paramātmānaṃ namāmyakhilakāraṇam..27..
3.32.d:
महादेव उवाच ॥
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम परं ज्योतिः सनातनम्॥
निर्लिप्तं परमात्मानं नमाम्यखिलकारणम्॥27॥
3.32.m:
The supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme eternal light, / unattached, the Paramātman, the cause of all—I bow to Him.
The god who is grosser than the grossest, supreme, subtler than the subtlest, / visible to all and invisible, acting according to his own will—I bow to Him.

3.32.s:
sthūlātsthūlatamaṃ devaṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatamaṃ param ..
sarvadṛśyamadṛśyaṃ ca svecchācāraṃ namāmyaham .. 28 ..
3.32.d:
स्थूलात्स्थूलतमं देवं सूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतमं परम् ॥
सर्वदृश्यमदृश्यं च स्वेच्छाचारं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.32.m:
With form and formless, with gunas and free from gunas, the Lord, / the support of all and everything itself, assuming forms by his own will—I bow to Him.
Bearing an exceedingly charming, matchless, all-pervading form, / and also bearing an utterly terrifying form—I bow down to Him.

3.32.s:
sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ prabhum ..
sarvādhāraṃ ca sarvaṃ ca svecchārūpaṃ namāmyaham ..29..
3.32.d:
साकारं च निराकारं सगुणं निर्गुणं प्रभुम् ॥
सर्वाधारं च सर्वं च स्वेच्छारूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥29॥
3.32.m:
The form of action belonging to action, the witness of all action, / the fruit and the giver of fruit, whose form is all—I bow to Him.
The creator, the protector, and the destroyer by parts through diversity of forms, / the Person who possesses manifold forms through parts and portions—I bow to Him.

3.32.s:
atīva kamanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ nirupamaṃ vibhum ..
karālarūpamatyantaṃ bibhrataṃ praṇamāmyaham .. 3.32.30 ..
3.32.d:
अतीव कमनीयं च रूपं निरुपमं विभुम् ॥
करालरूपमत्यन्तं बिभ्रतं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ 3.32.30 ॥
3.32.m:
The all-pervading lord of exceedingly lovely, peerless form,
and who assumes an extremely terrifying form, I bow to him. (3.32.30)

3.32.s:
karmmaṇaḥ karmarūpaṃ taṃ sākṣiṇaṃ sarvakarmaṇaḥ ..
phalaṃ ca phaladātāraṃ sarvarūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 31 ..
3.32.d:
कर्म्मणः कर्मरूपं तं साक्षिणं सर्वकर्मणः ॥
फलं च फलदातारं सर्वरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 31 ॥
3.32.m:
The embodied form of action, the witness to all actions,
the fruit and the giver of fruit, who has all forms—to him I bow. (31)

3.32.s:
sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃhartā kalayā mūrtibhedataḥ ..
nānāmūrtiḥ kalāṃśena yaḥ pumāṃstaṃ namāmyaham .. 32 ..
3.32.d:
स्रष्टा पाता च संहर्ता कलया मूर्तिभेदतः ॥
नानामूर्तिः कलांशेन यः पुमांस्तं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 32 ॥
3.32.m:
Creator, protector, and destroyer through his parts by distinctions of form,
the Puruṣa who has diverse forms through portions of his parts—to him I bow. (32)

3.32.s:
svayaṃ prakṛtirūpaśca māyayā ca svayaṃ pumān ..
tayoḥ paraṃ svayaṃ śaśvattannamāmi parātparam .. 33 ..
3.32.d:
स्वयं प्रकृतिरूपश्च मायया च स्वयं पुमान् ॥
तयोः परं स्वयं शश्वत्तन्नमामि परात्परम् ॥ 33 ॥
3.32.m:
He is Himself in the form of Prakṛti, and Himself the male [Puruṣa] through Māyā;
beyond both of them, He is Himself eternal. I bow down to that highest of the high. // 33

3.32.s:
strīpunnapuṃsakaṃ rūpaṃ yo bibharti svamāyayā ..
svayaṃ māyā svayaṃ māyī yo devastaṃ namāmyaham .. 34 ..
3.32.d:
स्त्रीपुन्नपुंसकं रूपं यो बिभर्ति स्वमायया ॥
स्वयं माया स्वयं मायी यो देवस्तं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 34 ॥
3.32.m:
Who by His own Māyā assumes the female, male, and neuter forms,
who is Himself Māyā and Himself the possessor of Māyā—to that God I bow down. // 34

3.32.s:
tārakaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ..
dhārakaṃ sarvaviśvānāṃ sarvabījaṃ namāmyaham .. 35 ..
3.32.d:
तारकं सर्वदुःखानां सर्वकारणकारणम् ॥
धारकं सर्वविश्वानां सर्वबीजं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 35 ॥
3.32.m:
The deliverer from all sorrows, the cause of all causes,
the sustainer of all universes, the seed of all—to Him I bow down. // 35

3.32.s:
tejasvināṃ raviryo hi sarvajātiṣu vāḍavaḥ ..
nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca yaścandrastaṃ namāmi jagatprabhum .. 36 ..
3.32.d:
तेजस्विनां रविर्यो हि सर्वजातिषु वाडवः ॥
नक्षत्राणां च यश्चन्द्रस्तं नमामि जगत्प्रभुम् ॥ 36 ॥
3.32.m:
Who is the sun among the luminous, the submarine fire among all classes,
and the moon among the constellations—to Him, the Lord of the world, I bow down. // 36

3.32.s:
rudrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jñānināṃ yo hi śaṅkaraḥ ..
nāgānāṃ yo hi śeṣaśca taṃ namāmi jagatpatim .. 37 ..
3.32.d:
रुद्राणां वैष्णवानां च ज्ञानिनां यो हि शङ्करः ॥
नागानां यो हि शेषश्च तं नमामि जगत्पतिम् ॥ 37 ॥
3.32.m:
Who is Śaṅkara among the Rudras, the Vaiṣṇavas, and the knowers,
and who is Śeṣa among the serpent-nāgas—to Him, the Lord of the world, I bow down. // 37

3.32.s:
prajāpatīnāṃ yo brahmā siddhānāṃ kapilaḥ svayam ..
sanatkumāro muniṣu taṃ namāmi jagadgurum..38..
3.32.d:
प्रजापतीनां यो ब्रह्मा सिद्धानां कपिलः स्वयम् ॥
सनत्कुमारो मुनिषु तं नमामि जगद्गुरुम्॥38॥
3.32.m:
Who is Brahmā among the Prajāpatis, Kapila himself among the Siddhas,
and Sanatkumāra among the sages—to Him, the Teacher of the world, I bow down. // 38

3.32.s:
devānāṃ yo hi viṣṇuśca devīnāṃ prakṛtiḥ svayam..
svāyambhuvo manūnāṃ yo mānaveṣu ca vaiṣṇavaḥ..
nārīṇāṃ śatarūpā ca bahurūpaṃ namāmyaham ..39..
3.32.d:
देवानां यो हि विष्णुश्च देवीनां प्रकृतिः स्वयम्॥
स्वायम्भुवो मनूनां यो मानवेषु च वैष्णवः॥
नारीणां शतरूपा च बहुरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥39॥
3.32.m:
Who is Viṣṇu among the gods, Prakṛti herself among the goddesses,
Svāyambhuva among the Manus, the Vaiṣṇava among humans,
and Śatarūpā among women—to that multiform One I bow down. // 39

3.32.s:
ṛtūnāṃ yo vasantaśca māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣakaḥ ..
ekādaśī tithīnāṃ ca namāmyakhilarūpiṇam ..3.32.40..
3.32.d:
ऋतूनां यो वसन्तश्च मासानां मार्गशीर्षकः ॥
एकादशी तिथीनां च नमाम्यखिलरूपिणम् ॥3.32.40॥
3.32.m:
Who is the spring among the seasons, Mārgaśīrṣa among the months,
and Ekādaśī among the lunar days—to the all-formed One I bow down. // 40

3.32.s:
sāgaraḥ saritāṃ yaśca parvatānāṃ himālayaḥ ..
vasundharā sahiṣṇūnāṃ taṃ sarvaṃ praṇamāmyaham ..41..
3.32.d:
सागरः सरितां यश्च पर्वतानां हिमालयः ॥
वसुन्धरा सहिष्णूनां तं सर्वं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥41॥
3.32.m:
Who is the ocean among rivers, the Himālaya among mountains,
and the earth among the patient—to that All I offer bowings. // 41

3.32.s:
patrāṇāṃ tulasīpatraṃ dārurūpeṣu candanam ..
vṛkṣāṇāṃ kalpavṛkṣo yastaṃ namāmi jagatpatim .. 42 ..
3.32.d:
पत्राणां तुलसीपत्रं दारुरूपेषु चन्दनम् ॥
वृक्षाणां कल्पवृक्षो यस्तं नमामि जगत्पतिम् ॥ 42 ॥
3.32.m:
The tulasī leaf among leaves, sandalwood among trees,
and the wish-fulfilling tree among trees—to Him, the Lord of the world, I bow down. // 42

3.32.s:
puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaśca sasyānāṃ dhānyameva ca ..
amṛtaṃ bhakṣyavastūnāṃ nānārūpaṃ namāmyaham..43..
3.32.d:
पुष्पाणां पारिजातश्च सस्यानां धान्यमेव च ॥
अमृतं भक्ष्यवस्तूनां नानारूपं नमाम्यहम्॥43॥
3.32.m:
The pārijāta flower among flowers, rice among grains,
and ambrosia among edible things—to Him of manifold forms I bow down. // 43

3.32.s:
airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām ..
kāmadhenuśca dhenūnāṃ sarvarūpaṃ namāmyaham..44..
3.32.d:
ऐरावतो गजेन्द्राणां वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥
कामधेनुश्च धेनूनां सर्वरूपं नमाम्यहम्॥44॥
3.32.m:
Airāvata among noble elephants, Garuḍa among birds,
and the wish-granting cow among cattle—to the all-formed One I bow down. // 44

3.32.s:
taijasānāṃ suvarṇaṃ ca dhānyānāṃ yava eva ca ..
yaḥ kesarī paśūnāṃ ca vararūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 49 ..
3.32.d:
तैजसानां सुवर्णं च धान्यानां यव एव च ॥
यः केसरी पशूनां च वररूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 49 ॥
3.32.m:
Gold among metals, barley among grains,
and the lion among beasts—to Him of supreme form I bow down. // 45

3.32.s:
yakṣāṇāṃ ca kubero yo grahāṇāṃ ca bṛhaspatiḥ ..
dikpālānāṃ mahendraśca taṃ namāmi paraṃ varam .. 46 ..
3.32.d:
यक्षाणां च कुबेरो यो ग्रहाणां च बृहस्पतिः ॥
दिक्पालानां महेन्द्रश्च तं नमामि परं वरम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.32.m:
Who is Kubera among the Yakṣas, Bṛhaspati among the planets,
and Mahendra among the guardians of the directions—to Him, the supreme boon, I bow down. // 46

3.32.s:
vedasaṃghaśca śāstrāṇāṃ paṇḍitānāṃ sarasvatī ..
akṣarāṇāmakāro yastaṃ pradhānaṃ namāmyaham .. 47 ..
3.32.d:
वेदसंघश्च शास्त्राणां पण्डितानां सरस्वती ॥
अक्षराणामकारो यस्तं प्रधानं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 47 ॥
3.32.m:
The collection of the Vedas among scriptures, Sarasvatī among scholars,
and the letter ‘a’ among syllables—to that primal One I bow down. // 47

3.32.s:
mantrāṇāṃ viṣṇumantraśca tīrthānāṃ jāhnavī svayam ..
indriyāṇāṃ mano yo hi sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ namāmyaham .. .. 48 ..
3.32.d:
मन्त्राणां विष्णुमन्त्रश्च तीर्थानां जाह्नवी स्वयम् ॥
इन्द्रियाणां मनो यो हि सर्वश्रेष्ठं नमाम्यहम् ॥ ॥ 48 ॥
3.32.m:
The Viṣṇu-mantra among mantras, Jāhnavī herself among sacred waters,
and the mind among the senses—to the best of all I bow down. // 48

3.32.s:
sudarśanaṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ vyādhināṃ vaiṣṇavo jvaraḥ ..
tejasāṃ brahmatejaśca vareṇyaṃ taṃ namāmyaham .. 49 ..
3.32.d:
सुदर्शनं च शस्त्राणां व्याधिनां वैष्णवो ज्वरः ॥
तेजसां ब्रह्मतेजश्च वरेण्यं तं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 49 ॥
3.32.m:
The Sudarśana among weapons, the Vaiṣṇava fever among afflictions,
and the brahma-splendour among splendours—to that most excellent One I bow down. // 49

3.32.s:
balaṃ yo vai balavatāṃ mano vai śīghragāminām ..
kālaḥ kalayatāṃ yo hi taṃ namāmi vilakṣaṇam ..3.32.50..
3.32.d:
बलं यो वै बलवतां मनो वै शीघ्रगामिनाम् ॥
कालः कलयतां यो हि तं नमामि विलक्षणम् ॥3.32.50॥
3.32.m:
Who is the strength of the strong, the mind among swift runners,
and Time among the reckoners—to Him, distinct and wondrous, I bow down. // 50

3.32.s:
jñānadātā gurūṇāṃ ca mātṛrūpaśca bandhuṣu .
mitreṣu janmadātā yastaṃ sāraṃ praṇamāmyaham ..51..
3.32.d:
ज्ञानदाता गुरूणां च मातृरूपश्च बन्धुषु ।
मित्रेषु जन्मदाता यस्तं सारं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥51॥
3.32.m: The giver of knowledge among gurus, the mother among relatives, / and the progenitor among friends—to Him, the essence, I bow down. // 51

3.32.s:
śilpināṃ viśvakarmā yaḥ kāmadevaśca rūpiṇām ..
pativratā ca patnīnāṃ namasyaṃ taṃ namāmyaham .. 52 ..
3.32.d:
शिल्पिनां विश्वकर्मा यः कामदेवश्च रूपिणाम् ॥
पतिव्रता च पत्नीनां नमस्यं तं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 52 ॥
3.32.m:
Who is Viśvakarman among craftsmen, Kāmadeva among the beautiful,
and the devoted wife among wives—to Him, worthy of worship, I bow down. // 52

3.32.s:
priyeṣu putrarūpo yo nṛparūpo nareṣu ca ..
śālagrāmaśca yantrāṇāṃ taṃ viśiṣṭaṃ namāmyaham .. 53 ..
3.32.d:
प्रियेषु पुत्ररूपो यो नृपरूपो नरेषु च ॥
शालग्रामश्च यन्त्राणां तं विशिष्टं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 53 ॥
3.32.m:
Who is the son among loved ones, the king among men,
and the Śāligrāma among sacred symbols—to Him, the distinguished One, I bow down. // 53

3.32.s:
dharmmaḥ kalyāṇabījānāṃ vedānāṃ sāmavedakaḥ ..
dharmmāṇāṃ satyarūpo yo viśiṣṭaṃ taṃ namāmyaham .. 54 ..
3.32.d:
धर्म्मः कल्याणबीजानां वेदानां सामवेदकः ॥
धर्म्माणां सत्यरूपो यो विशिष्टं तं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 54 ॥
3.32.m:
Dharma among seeds of auspiciousness, the Sāmaveda among the Vedas,
and truth among virtues—to Him, the distinguished One, I bow down. // 54

3.32.s:
jale śaityasvarūpo yo gandharūpaśca bhūmiṣu ..
śabdarūpaśca gagane taṃ praṇamya namāmyaham .. 55 ..
3.32.d:
जले शैत्यस्वरूपो यो गन्धरूपश्च भूमिषु ॥
शब्दरूपश्च गगने तं प्रणम्य नमाम्यहम् ॥ 55 ॥
3.32.m:
and sound in the ether—having bowed before Him, I bow down. // 55
Who is coolness in water, fragrance in the earth,

3.32.s:
kratūnāṃ rājasūyo yo gāyatrī chandasāṃ ca yaḥ ..
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathastaṃ gariṣṭhaṃ namāmyaham ..56..
3.32.d:
क्रतूनां राजसूयो यो गायत्री छन्दसां च यः ॥
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथस्तं गरिष्ठं नमाम्यहम् ॥56॥
3.32.m:
Who is the Rājasūya among sacrifices, the Gāyatrī among metres,
and Citraratha among the Gandharvas—to Him, the most venerable, I bow down. // 56

3.32.s:
kṣīrasvarūpo gavyānāṃ pavitrāṇāṃ ca pāvakaḥ..
puṇyadānāṃ ca yaḥ stotraṃ taṃ namāmi śubhapradam ..57..
3.32.d:
क्षीरस्वरूपो गव्यानां पवित्राणां च पावकः॥
पुण्यदानां च यः स्तोत्रं तं नमामि शुभप्रदम् ॥57॥
3.32.m:
The milk among the products of the cow, fire among purifiers,
and the hymn of praise among givers of merit—to Him, bestower of good, I bow down. // 57

3.32.s:
tṛṇānāṃ kuśarūpo yo vyādhirūpaśca vairiṇām ..
guṇānāṃ śāntarūpo yaścitrarūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 58 ..
3.32.d:
तृणानां कुशरूपो यो व्याधिरूपश्च वैरिणाम् ॥
गुणानां शान्तरूपो यश्चित्ररूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.32.m:
Who is kuśa among grasses, sickness to enemies,
and tranquility among qualities—to Him of wondrous forms I bow down. // 58

3.32.s:
tejorūpo jñānarūpaḥ sarvarūpaśca yo mahān..
sarvānirvacanīyaṃ ca taṃ namāmi svayaṃ vibhum..59..
3.32.d:
तेजोरूपो ज्ञानरूपः सर्वरूपश्च यो महान्॥
सर्वानिर्वचनीयं च तं नमामि स्वयं विभुम्॥59॥
3.32.m:
The great One who is the embodiment of splendour, of knowledge, and of all,
ineffable in all respects—to Him, the sovereign Lord Himself, I bow down. // 59

3.32.s:
sarvādhāreṣu yo vāyuryathā''tmā nityarūpiṇām ..
ākāśo vyāpakānāṃ yo vyāpakaṃ taṃ namāmyaham .. 3.32.60 ..
3.32.d:
सर्वाधारेषु यो वायुर्यथा'ऽत्मा नित्यरूपिणाम् ॥
आकाशो व्यापकानां यो व्यापकं तं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 3.32.60 ॥
3.32.m:
Who is the wind among all receptacles, just as the Self is among eternal beings,
and space among all-pervading things—to Him, the all-pervading One, I bow down. // 60

3.32.s:
vedānirvacanīyaṃ yanna stotuṃ paṇḍitaḥ kṣamaḥ ..
yadanirvacanīyaṃ ca ko vā tatstotumīśvaraḥ .. 61 ..
3.32.d:
वेदानिर्वचनीयं यन्न स्तोतुं पण्डितः क्षमः ॥
यदनिर्वचनीयं च को वा तत्स्तोतुमीश्वरः ॥ 61 ॥
3.32.m:
Whom the Vedas cannot describe, whom no learned man is able to praise;
and since He is beyond expression, who indeed is capable of praising Him? // 61

3.32.s:
vedā na śaktā yaṃ stotuṃ jaḍībhūtā sarasvatī ..
taṃ ca vāṅmanasāpāraṃ ko vidvānstotumīśvaraḥ ..62..
3.32.d:
वेदा न शक्ता यं स्तोतुं जडीभूता सरस्वती ॥
तं च वाङ्मनसापारं को विद्वान्स्तोतुमीश्वरः ॥62॥
3.32.m:
Whom the Vedas are not able to praise, and Sarasvatī becomes stunned [before Him];
and who is beyond words and mind—what wise man is able to praise Him? // 62

3.32.s:
śuddhatejassvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham ..
atīva kamanīyaṃ ca śyāmarūpaṃ namāmyaham ..63..
3.32.d:
शुद्धतेजस्स्वरूपं च भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहम् ॥
अतीव कमनीयं च श्यामरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥63॥
3.32.m:
Whose essential nature is pure splendour, whose form is assumed out of grace toward his devotees,
Exceedingly lovely and dark in form—to him I bow.

3.32.s:
dvibhujaṃ muralīvaktraṃ kiśoraṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ..
śaśvadgopāṅganābhiśca vīkṣyamāṇaṃ namāmyaham..64..
3.32.d:
द्विभुजं मुरलीवक्त्रं किशोरं सस्मितं मुदा ॥
शश्वद्गोपाङ्गनाभिश्च वीक्ष्यमाणं नमाम्यहम्॥64॥
3.32.m:
Two-armed, with the flute at his mouth, an adolescent, smiling with joy,
Constantly gazed upon by the cowherd women—to him I bow.

3.32.s:
rādhayā dattatāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ manoharam..
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca tamīśaṃ praṇamāmyaham..65..
3.32.d:
राधया दत्तताम्बूलं भुक्तवन्तं मनोहरम्॥
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं च तमीशं प्रणमाम्यहम्॥65॥
3.32.m:
Who enjoys the charming betel leaf offered by Rādhā,
And who sits upon a jewel throne—to that Lord I bow down.

3.32.s:
ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaṃ sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ..
pārṣadapravarairgopakumāraistaṃ namāmyaham..66..
3.32.d:
रत्नभूषणभूषाढ्यं सेवितं श्वेतचामरैः॥
पार्षदप्रवरैर्गोपकुमारैस्तं नमाम्यहम्॥66॥
3.32.m:
Adorned with jewelled ornaments, attended with white fly-whisks
By the foremost companions, the young cowherds—to him I bow.

3.32.s:
vṛndāvanāntare ramye rāsollāsasamutsukam..
rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ namāmi rasikeśvaram .. 67 ..
3.32.d:
वृन्दावनान्तरे रम्ये रासोल्लाससमुत्सुकम्॥
रासमण्डलमध्यस्थं नमामि रसिकेश्वरम् ॥ 67 ॥
3.32.m:
Eager for the delight of the rāsa dance within the delightful Vṛndāvana,
Stationed in the midst of the rāsa circle—I bow to the Lord of lovers.

3.32.s:
śataśṛṅge mahāśaile goloke ratnaparvate ..
virajāpuline ramye praṇamāmi vihāriṇam..68..
3.32.d:
शतशृङ्गे महाशैले गोलोके रत्नपर्वते ॥
विरजापुलिने रम्ये प्रणमामि विहारिणम्॥68॥
3.32.m:
On the great mountain Śataśṛṅga, on the jewel mountain in Goloka,
Sporting on the delightful bank of the Virajā—to him I bow down.

3.32.s:
paripūrṇatamaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam ..
satyaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ ca nityaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ namāmyaham .. 69 ..
3.32.d:
परिपूर्णतमं शान्तं राधाकान्तं मनोहरम् ॥
सत्यं ब्रह्मस्वरूपं च नित्यं कृष्णं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 69 ॥
3.32.m:
The most complete, tranquil, beloved of Rādhā, enchanting,
The truth, the essential nature of Brahman, eternal—to Kṛṣṇa I bow.

3.32.s:
śrīkṛṣṇasya stotramidaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ..
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sa dātā bhārate bhavet .. 3.32.70 ..
3.32.d:
श्रीकृष्णस्य स्तोत्रमिदं त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नरः॥
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां स दाता भारते भवेत् ॥ 3.32.70 ॥
3.32.m:
A man who recites this hymn of praise to Śrī Kṛṣṇa at the three junctions of the day
Becomes a bestower of righteousness, wealth, desire, and liberation in Bhārata.

3.32.s:
haridāsyaṃ harau bhaktiṃ labhetstotraprasādataḥ ..
iha loke jagatpūjyo viṣṇutulyo bhaveddhruvam .. 71 ..
3.32.d:
हरिदास्यं हरौ भक्तिं लभेत्स्तोत्रप्रसादतः ॥
इह लोके जगत्पूज्यो विष्णुतुल्यो भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 71 ॥
3.32.m:
By the grace of the hymn of praise he attains servitude to Hari and devotion to Hari;
In this world he is worshipful to the universe and surely becomes equal to Viṣṇu.

3.32.s:
sarvasiddheśvaraḥ śānto'pyante yāti hareḥ padam ..
tejasā yaśasā bhāti yathā sūryyo mahītale..72..
3.32.d:
सर्वसिद्धेश्वरः शान्तोऽप्यन्ते याति हरेः पदम् ॥
तेजसा यशसा भाति यथा सूर्य्यो महीतले॥72॥
3.32.m:
Lord of all perfections, tranquil, he goes at last to the abode of Hari;
He shines upon the earth with splendour and fame like the sun.

3.32.s:
jīvanmuktaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ ..
arogī guṇavānvidvānputravāndhanavānsadā .. 73 ..
3.32.d:
जीवन्मुक्तः कृष्णभक्तः स भवेन्नात्र संशयः ॥
अरोगी गुणवान्विद्वान्पुत्रवान्धनवान्सदा ॥ 73 ॥
3.32.m:
He becomes liberated in life and a devotee of Kṛṣṇa; of this there is no doubt;
He is always free from illness, virtuous, learned, having sons and wealth.

3.32.s:
ṣaḍabhijño daśabalo manoyāyī bhaveddhruvam ..
sarvajñaḥ sarvadaścaiva sa dātā sarvasampadām ..
kalpavṛkṣasamaḥ śaśvadbhavetkṛṣṇaprasādataḥ .. 74 ..
3.32.d:
षडभिज्ञो दशबलो मनोयायी भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
सर्वज्ञः सर्वदश्चैव स दाता सर्वसम्पदाम् ॥
कल्पवृक्षसमः शश्वद्भवेत्कृष्णप्रसादतः ॥ 74 ॥

3.32.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ stotraṃ vatsa tvaṃ gaccha puṣkaram ..
tatra kṛtvā mantrasiddhiṃ paścātprāpsyasi vāñchitam .. 75 ..
3.32.d:
इत्येवं कथितं स्तोत्रं वत्स त्वं गच्छ पुष्करम् ॥
तत्र कृत्वा मन्त्रसिद्धिं पश्चात्प्राप्स्यसि वाञ्छितम् ॥ 75 ॥
3.32.m:
Thus has this hymn of praise been told to you. Go, child, to Puṣkara;
Having attained mastery of the mantra there, you will afterwards obtain what you desire.

3.32.s:
trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kuru pṛthvīṃ yathāsukham ..
mamāśiṣā muniśreṣṭha śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādataḥ .. 76 ..
3.32.d:
त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां कुरु पृथ्वीं यथासुखम् ॥
ममाशिषा मुनिश्रेष्ठ श्रीकृष्णस्य प्रसादतः ॥ 76 ॥
3.32.m:
Make the earth rid of kings twenty-one times, as you please,
By my blessing, O best of sages, and by the grace of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

3.33.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śivaṃ praṇamya sa bhṛgurdurgāṃ kālīṃ mudā'nvitaḥ ..
gatvā puṣkaratīrtha ca mantrasiddhiṃ cakāra ha.1..
3.33.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
शिवं प्रणम्य स भृगुर्दुर्गां कालीं मुदाऽन्वितः ॥
गत्वा पुष्करतीर्थ च मन्त्रसिद्धिं चकार ह.1॥
3.33.m: Nārāyaṇa said: / Having bowed to Śiva, Durgā, and Kālī, filled with joy, / that descendant of Bhṛgu went to the sacred bath of Puṣkara and attained mastery of the mantra. //1// / Endowed with devotion, he went without food for a month; / meditating on the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, he suspended his breath. //2// / Opening his eyes, he saw the sky covered with brilliance, / illuminating the ten directions and concealing the sun. //3// / In the midst of the sphere of brilliance he saw a jewelled vehicle; / and there he saw an exceedingly handsome, supreme person, //4// / Whose face was gracious with a slight smile, who shows grace to his devotees. / Bowing like a staff with his head, he chose a boon from that Lord: //5// / 'I shall rid the earth of kings twenty-one times. / Grant me very firm, unfailing devotion to your lotus feet, //6// / And grant me servitude to your lotus feet, constantly very difficult to obtain.' / Having granted him the boon, Kṛṣṇa vanished right there. //7// / Bowing to that supreme abode, the descendant of Bhṛgu departed; / and his right side twitched, indicating the highest good fortune. //8// / He had an auspicious dream producing confidence in his desire, / and his mind became serene and elevated day and night; / having spoken to all his kinsmen, he stayed in his house, filled with joy. //9// / Bringing together his own disciples, his father's disciples, his brothers, and his kinsmen, / he repeatedly held various mantras [with them]. //10// / Having told them all his own story in order at an auspicious moment, / he, becoming powerful, prepared to march along with them. //11// / Rāma saw good omens and heard sounds indicating victory; / he understood in his mind his own victory and the destruction of the enemies. //12// / And at the time of departure, the sage suddenly heard ahead / the name of Hari, the roar of a lion, and the sounding of bells and kettledrums; //13// / The singing of a voice from the sky saying, 'Victory shall be yours!', / and fresh, auspicious signs, and the rumbling of clouds bringing victory. //14

3.33.s:
sa babhūva nirāhāro māsaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ ..
dhyāyankṛṣṇapadāmbhojaṃ vāyurodhaṃ cakāra saḥ ..2..
3.33.d:
स बभूव निराहारो मासं भक्तिसमन्वितः ॥
ध्यायन्कृष्णपदाम्भोजं वायुरोधं चकार सः ॥2॥

3.33.s:
dadarśa cakṣurunmīlya gaganaṃ tejasā vṛtam ..
diśo daśa dyotayantaṃ samācchannadivākaram ..3..
3.33.d:
ददर्श चक्षुरुन्मील्य गगनं तेजसा वृतम् ॥
दिशो दश द्योतयन्तं समाच्छन्नदिवाकरम् ॥3॥

3.33.s:
tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ ratnayānaṃ dadarśa ha ..
dadarśa tatra puruṣamatyantaṃ sundaraṃ varam..4..
3.33.d:
तेजोमण्डलमध्यस्थं रत्नयानं ददर्श ह ॥
ददर्श तत्र पुरुषमत्यन्तं सुन्दरं वरम्॥4॥

3.33.s:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ..
praṇamya daṇḍavanmūrdhnā varaṃ vavre tamīśvaram ..5..
3.33.d:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं भक्तानुग्रहकारकम् ॥
प्रणम्य दण्डवन्मूर्ध्ना वरं वव्रे तमीश्वरम् ॥5॥

3.33.s:
trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyāmi mahīmiti ..
pādāravinde sudṛḍhāṃ tāṃ bhaktimanapāyinīm..6..
3.33.d:
त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां करिष्यामि महीमिति ॥
पादारविन्दे सुदृढां तां भक्तिमनपायिनीम्॥6॥

3.33.s:
dāsyaṃ sudurllabhaṃ śaśvavatpādābje ca dehi me ..
kṛṣṇastasmai varaṃ dattvā tatraivāntaradhīyata..7..
3.33.d:
दास्यं सुदुर्ल्लभं शश्ववत्पादाब्जे च देहि मे ॥
कृष्णस्तस्मै वरं दत्त्वा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥7॥

3.33.s:
bhṛguḥ praṇamya bhavanaṃ tajjagāma parātparam..
paspanda dakṣiṇāṅgaṃ ca paraṃ maṅgalasūcakam..8..
3.33.d:
भृगुः प्रणम्य भवनं तज्जगाम परात्परम्॥
पस्पन्द दक्षिणाङ्गं च परं मङ्गलसूचकम्॥8॥

3.33.s:
vāñchā pratītijananaṃ susvapnaṃ ca dadarśa ha ..
manaḥ prasannaṃ sphītaṃ ca tadbabhūva divāniśam ..
bhāṣya svajanaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhe tasthau mudā'nvitaḥ .. .. 9 ..
3.33.d:
वाञ्छा प्रतीतिजननं सुस्वप्नं च ददर्श ह ॥
मनः प्रसन्नं स्फीतं च तद्बभूव दिवानिशम् ॥
भाष्य स्वजनं सर्वं गृहे तस्थौ मुदाऽन्वितः ॥ ॥ 9 ॥

3.33.s:
svaśiṣyānpitṛśiṣyāṃśca bhrātṛvargāṃśca bāndhavān ..
ānīyānīya vividhānmantrāṃśca sa cakāra ha ..3.33.10..
3.33.d:
स्वशिष्यान्पितृशिष्यांश्च भ्रातृवर्गांश्च बान्धवान् ॥
आनीयानीय विविधान्मन्त्रांश्च स चकार ह ॥3.33.10॥

3.33.s:
paurvāparyyaṃ svavṛttāntaṃ tānevoktvā śubhakṣaṇe ..
taireva sārddhaṃ balavānbabhūva gamanonmukhaḥ .. 11 ..
3.33.d:
पौर्वापर्य्यं स्ववृत्तान्तं तानेवोक्त्वा शुभक्षणे ॥
तैरेव सार्द्धं बलवान्बभूव गमनोन्मुखः ॥ 11 ॥

3.33.s:
dadarśa maṅgalaṃ rāmaḥ śuśrāva jayasūcakam ..
bubudhe manasā sarvaṃ svajayaṃ vairisaṃkṣayam..12..
3.33.d:
ददर्श मङ्गलं रामः शुश्राव जयसूचकम् ॥
बुबुधे मनसा सर्वं स्वजयं वैरिसंक्षयम्॥12॥

3.33.s:
yātrākāle ca purataḥ śuśrāva sahasā muniḥ ..
hariśabdaṃ siṃhaśabdaṃ ghaṇṭādundubhivādanam..13..
3.33.d:
यात्राकाले च पुरतः शुश्राव सहसा मुनिः ॥
हरिशब्दं सिंहशब्दं घण्टादुन्दुभिवादनम्॥13॥

3.33.s:
ākāśavāṇīsaṃgītaṃ jayaste bhaviteti ca ..
naveṅgitaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ meghaśabdaṃ jayāvaham ..14..
3.33.d:
आकाशवाणीसंगीतं जयस्ते भवितेति च ॥
नवेङ्गितं च कल्याणं मेघशब्दं जयावहम् ॥14॥

3.33.s:
cakāra yātrāṃ bhagavāñchrutvaivaṃ vividhaṃ śubham ..
dadarśa purato viprabandidaivajñabhikṣukān ..15..
3.33.d:
चकार यात्रां भगवाञ्छ्रुत्वैवं विविधं शुभम् ॥
ददर्श पुरतो विप्रबन्दिदैवज्ञभिक्षुकान् ॥15॥
3.33.m: Having heard of such various auspicious [omens], the blessed one set out on his journey. / He saw in front of him brāhmaṇas, bards, astrologers, and beggars; / in front, he saw a smiling, chaste woman adorned with various ornaments, / holding a burning lamp, with living husband and sons. / Śiva, a vixen, a full water-jar, a blue jay, and a mongoose: / as he walked, Rāma saw these that indicated auspiciousness for his journey; / a blackbuck, an elephant, a lion, a horse, a rhinoceros, a tusker, / a yak, a royal swan, a cakravāka duck, a parrot, a cuckoo, / a peacock, a wagtail, a kite, a cakora bird, / a pigeon, a crane, a kāraṇḍava duck, a cātaka bird, a sparrow, / lightning, Indra's bow, the sun, the radiant, auspicious sunshine, / fresh meat, live fish, a conch shell, gold, / a ruby, silver, a pearl, a precious gem, coral, / curd, parched grain, white rice, white flowers, saffron, / betel leaves, a banner, an umbrella, a mirror, a white fly-whisk, / a cow with its calf, a king seated on a chariot, / milk, ghee, betel nut, nectar, milk rice, / a Śāligrāma stone, ripe fruit, a svastika sweet, sugar, honey, / a cat, a noble bull, a ram, a mountain mouse, / the rising of the sun veiled by clouds, the lunar disc, / musk, a fan, water, turmeric, clay from sacred bathing places, / white mustard, mustard seed, dūrvā grass, a brāhmaṇa boy, and a young girl, / a deer, a courtesan, a bee, camphor, one clad in yellow, / cow urine, cow dung, the dust of cows' hooves, [ground] marked with cow footprints, / a cow-pen, a cattle path, a charming cow-shed, the auspicious gait of cows, / an ornament, the image of a god, a blazing fire, a great festival, / copper, crystal, what is worthy of veneration, vermilion, a flower garland with sandal paste, / fragrant scent, a diamond, and precious jewels: on his right, he saw these auspicious things.

3.33.s:
jvalatpradīpaṃ dadhatīṃ patiputravatīṃ satīm..
puro dadarśa smerāsyāṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .. .. 16 ..
3.33.d:
ज्वलत्प्रदीपं दधतीं पतिपुत्रवतीं सतीम्॥
पुरो ददर्श स्मेरास्यां नानाभूषणभूषिताम् ॥ ॥ 16 ॥

3.33.s:
śivaṃ śivāṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ cāṣaṃ ca nakulaṃ tathā ..
gacchandadarśa rāmaśca yātrāmaṃgalasūcakam .. 17 ..
3.33.d:
शिवं शिवां पूर्णकुम्भं चाषं च नकुलं तथा ॥
गच्छन्ददर्श रामश्च यात्रामंगलसूचकम् ॥ 17 ॥

3.33.s:
kṛṣṇasāraṃ gajaṃ siṃhaṃ turagaṃ gaṇḍakaṃ dvipam ..
camarīṃ rājahaṃsaṃ ca cakravākaṃ śukaṃ pikam .. 18 ..
3.33.d:
कृष्णसारं गजं सिंहं तुरगं गण्डकं द्विपम् ॥
चमरीं राजहंसं च चक्रवाकं शुकं पिकम् ॥ 18 ॥

3.33.s:
mayūraṃ khañjanaṃ caiva śaṃkhacillaṃ cakorakam ..
pārāvataṃ balākaṃ ca kāraṇḍaṃ cātakaṃ caṭam .. 19 ..
3.33.d:
मयूरं खञ्जनं चैव शंखचिल्लं चकोरकम् ॥
पारावतं बलाकं च कारण्डं चातकं चटम् ॥ 19 ॥

3.33.s:
saudāmanīṃ śakracāpaṃ sūryyaṃ sūryāprabhāṃ śubhām ..
sadyomāṃsaṃ sajīvaṃ ca matsyaṃ śaṅkhaṃ suvarṇakam .. 3.33.20 ..
3.33.d:
सौदामनीं शक्रचापं सूर्य्यं सूर्याप्रभां शुभाम् ॥
सद्योमांसं सजीवं च मत्स्यं शङ्खं सुवर्णकम् ॥ 3.33.20 ॥

3.33.s:
māṇikyaṃ rajataṃ muktāṃ maṇīndraṃ ca pravālakam ..
dadhi lājāñchukladhānyaṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ ca kuṅkumam .. 21 ..
3.33.d:
माणिक्यं रजतं मुक्तां मणीन्द्रं च प्रवालकम् ॥
दधि लाजाञ्छुक्लधान्यं शुक्लपुष्पं च कुङ्कुमम् ॥ 21 ॥

3.33.s:
parṇaṃ patākāṃ chatraṃ ca darpaṇaṃ śvetacāmaram ..
dhenuṃ vatsaprayuktāṃ ca rathasthaṃ bhūmipaṃ tathā .. 22 ..
3.33.d:
पर्णं पताकां छत्रं च दर्पणं श्वेतचामरम् ॥
धेनुं वत्सप्रयुक्तां च रथस्थं भूमिपं तथा ॥ 22 ॥

3.33.s:
dugdhamājyaṃ tathā pūgamamṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā ..
śālagrāmaṃ pakvaphalaṃ svastikaṃ śarkarāṃ madhu ..23..
3.33.d:
दुग्धमाज्यं तथा पूगममृतं पायसं तथा ॥
शालग्रामं पक्वफलं स्वस्तिकं शर्करां मधु ॥23॥

3.33.s:
mārjjāraṃ ca vṛṣendraṃ ca meṣaṃ parvatamūṣikam ..
meghācchannasya ca raverudayaṃ candramaṇḍalam'.. .. 24 ..
3.33.d:
मार्ज्जारं च वृषेन्द्रं च मेषं पर्वतमूषिकम् ॥
मेघाच्छन्नस्य च रवेरुदयं चन्द्रमण्डलम्'॥ ॥ 24 ॥

3.33.s:
kastūrīṃ vyajanaṃ toyaṃ haridrāṃ tīrthamṛttikām ..
siddhārthaṃ sarṣapaṃ dūrvāṃ vipravālaṃ ca bālikām .. 25 ..
3.33.d:
कस्तूरीं व्यजनं तोयं हरिद्रां तीर्थमृत्तिकाम् ॥
सिद्धार्थं सर्षपं दूर्वां विप्रवालं च बालिकाम् ॥ 25 ॥

3.33.s:
mṛgaṃ veśyāṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ ca karpūraṃ pītavāsasam .. go
mūtraṃ gopurīṣaṃ ca godhūliṃ gopadāṅkitam .. 26 ..
3.33.d:
मृगं वेश्यां षट्पदं च कर्पूरं पीतवाससम् ॥ गो
मूत्रं गोपुरीषं च गोधूलिं गोपदाङ्कितम् ॥ 26 ॥

3.33.s:
goṣṭhaṃ gavāṃ vartma ramyāṃ gośālāṃ gogatiṃ śubhām ..
bhūṣaṇaṃ devamūrtiṃ ca jvaladagniṃ mahotsavam ..27..
3.33.d:
गोष्ठं गवां वर्त्म रम्यां गोशालां गोगतिं शुभाम् ॥
भूषणं देवमूर्तिं च ज्वलदग्निं महोत्सवम् ॥27॥

3.33.s:
tāmraṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ vandyaṃ sindūraṃ mālyacandanam ..
gandhaṃ ca hīrakaṃ ratnaṃ dadarśa dakṣiṇe śubham ..28..
3.33.d:
ताम्रं च स्फटिकं वन्द्यं सिन्दूरं माल्यचन्दनम् ॥
गन्धं च हीरकं रत्नं ददर्श दक्षिणे शुभम् ॥28॥

3.33.s: sugandhivāyorāghrāṇaṃ prāpa viprāśiṣaṃ śubhām .. 29 ..
3.33.d: सुगन्धिवायोराघ्राणं प्राप विप्राशिषं शुभाम् ॥ 29 ॥
3.33.m: He caught the fragrance of sweet-scented wind and received the auspicious blessings of brāhmaṇas. / Knowing these to be auspicious, he went forth filled with joy. / When the sun had set near the bank of the Narmadā, / there he saw the divine, extremely delightful Akṣayavaṭa, / very high and expansive, a supremely sacred hermitage, / the place of Paulastya’s austerity, endowed with fragrant winds; / near Kārtavīryārjuna he remained there with his followers. / Served by his servants, he slept upon a bed of flowers; / worn out, he went to sleep, filled with supreme bliss. / When the night had passed, that Bhṛgu saw a wondrous dream, / unthought-of by the mind, independent of [the humours] wind, bile, and phlegm: / himself being mounted upon elephants, horses, mountains, palaces, cows, and fruitful trees; / himself weeping and being eaten by worms; / himself boarding a boat, anointed with sandal paste, / wearing a garland of flowers, and adorned with yellow garments; / all his limbs smeared with feces and urine, covered with fat and pus; / and he saw himself playing an excellent vīṇā; / on the riverbank, upon broad lotus leaves, he saw himself / eating milk rice mixed with curd, ghee, and honey; / chewing betel, receiving the blessings of brāhmaṇas, / and seeing fruits, flowers, and lamps;

3.33.s:
ityevaṃ maṅgalaṃ jñātvā prayayau sa mudā'nvitaḥ ..
astaṃ gate dinakare narmmadātīrasannidhau..3.33.30..
3.33.d:
इत्येवं मङ्गलं ज्ञात्वा प्रययौ स मुदाऽन्वितः ॥
अस्तं गते दिनकरे नर्म्मदातीरसन्निधौ॥3.33.30॥

3.33.s:
tatrākṣayavaṭaṃ divyaṃ dadarśa sumanoharam ..
atyūrdhvaṃ vistṛtamatipuṇyāśramapadaṃ param..3 1..
3.33.d:
तत्राक्षयवटं दिव्यं ददर्श सुमनोहरम् ॥
अत्यूर्ध्वं विस्तृतमतिपुण्याश्रमपदं परम्॥3 1॥

3.33.s:
paulastyatapasaḥ sthānaṃ sugandhimarudanvitam..
kārtavīryyārjunābhyāśe tatra tasthau gaṇaiḥ saha..32..
3.33.d:
पौलस्त्यतपसः स्थानं सुगन्धिमरुदन्वितम्॥
कार्तवीर्य्यार्जुनाभ्याशे तत्र तस्थौ गणैः सह॥32॥

3.33.s:
suṣvāpa puṣpaśayyāyāṃ kiṅkaraiḥ parisevitaḥ..
nidrāṃ yayau pariśrāntaḥ paramānandasaṃgataḥ..33..
3.33.d:
सुष्वाप पुष्पशय्यायां किङ्करैः परिसेवितः॥
निद्रां ययौ परिश्रान्तः परमानन्दसंगतः॥33॥

3.33.s:
niśātīte ca sa bhṛguścāru svapnaṃ dadarśa ha ..
na cintitaṃ yanmanasā vāyupittakaphaṃ vinā .. 34 ..
3.33.d:
निशातीते च स भृगुश्चारु स्वप्नं ददर्श ह ॥
न चिन्तितं यन्मनसा वायुपित्तकफं विना ॥ 34 ॥

3.33.s:
gajāśvaśailaprāsādagovṛkṣaphaliteṣu ca ..
āruhyamāṇamātmānaṃ rudantaṃ kṛmibhakṣitam .. 35 ..
3.33.d:
गजाश्वशैलप्रासादगोवृक्षफलितेषु च ॥
आरुह्यमाणमात्मानं रुदन्तं कृमिभक्षितम् ॥ 35 ॥

3.33.s:
āruhyamāṇamātmānaṃ naukāyāṃ candanokṣitam ..
dhṛtavantaṃ puṣpamālāṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā .. 36 ..
3.33.d:
आरुह्यमाणमात्मानं नौकायां चन्दनोक्षितम् ॥
धृतवन्तं पुष्पमालां शोभितं पीतवाससा ॥ 36 ॥

3.33.s:
viṇmūtrokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ vasāpūyasamanvitam ..
vīṇāṃ varāṃ vādayantamātmānaṃ ca dadarśa ha .. 37 ..
3.33.d:
विण्मूत्रोक्षितसर्वांगं वसापूयसमन्वितम् ॥
वीणां वरां वादयन्तमात्मानं च ददर्श ह ॥ 37 ॥

3.33.s:
vistīrṇapadmapattraiśca svaṃ dadarśa sarittaṭe ..
dadhyājyamadhusaṃyuktaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca pāyasam .. 38 ..
3.33.d:
विस्तीर्णपद्मपत्त्रैश्च स्वं ददर्श सरित्तटे ॥
दध्याज्यमधुसंयुक्तं भुक्तवन्तं च पायसम् ॥ 38 ॥

3.33.s:
bhuktavantaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ labhantaṃ brāhmaṇāśiṣam..
phalapuṣpapradīpaṃ ca paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha..39.
3.33.d:
भुक्तवन्तं च ताम्बूलं लभन्तं ब्राह्मणाशिषम्॥
फलपुष्पप्रदीपं च पश्यन्तं स्वं ददर्श ह॥39.

3.33.s:
paripakvaphalaṃ kṣīramuṣṇānnaṃ śarkarānvitam ..
svastikaṃ bhuktavantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ca punaḥ punaḥ .. 3.33.40 ..
3.33.d:
परिपक्वफलं क्षीरमुष्णान्नं शर्करान्वितम् ॥
स्वस्तिकं भुक्तवन्तं स्वं ददर्श च पुनः पुनः ॥ 3.33.40 ॥
3.33.m:
fully ripe fruit, milk, hot food with sugar,
and svastika cakes: he saw himself eating them again and again.

3.33.s:
jalaukasā vṛścikena mīnena bhujagena ca ..
bhakṣitaṃ bhītamātmānaṃ palāyantaṃ dadarśa saḥ .. .. 41 ..
3.33.d:
जलौकसा वृश्चिकेन मीनेन भुजगेन च ॥
भक्षितं भीतमात्मानं पलायन्तं ददर्श सः ॥ ॥ 41 ॥
3.33.m:
By a leech, a scorpion, a fish, and a snake,
he saw himself being bitten, frightened, and running away.

3.33.s:
tato dadarśa cātmānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ candrasūryyayoḥ ..
patiputravatīṃ nārīṃ paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ dvijaḥ .. 42 ..
3.33.d:
ततो ददर्श चात्मानं मण्डलं चन्द्रसूर्य्ययोः ॥
पतिपुत्रवतीं नारीं पश्यन्तं सस्मितं द्विजः ॥ 42 ॥
3.33.m:
Then the twice-born saw himself looking with a smile
at the orb of the sun and moon, and at a woman with a living husband and sons.

3.33.s:
suveṣayā kanyakā sa smitena dvijena ca ..
dadarśa śliṣṭamātmānaṃ tuṣṭena parituṣṭayā .. 43 ..
3.33.d:
सुवेषया कन्यका स स्मितेन द्विजेन च ॥
ददर्श श्लिष्टमात्मानं तुष्टेन परितुष्टया ॥ 43 ॥
3.33.m:
By a well-dressed maiden, and by a smiling brāhmaṇa,
contented, he saw himself embraced by the delighted [maiden].

3.33.s:
phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ devatāpratimāṃ nṛpam ..
gajasthaṃ ca rathasthaṃ ca paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha .. 44 ..
3.33.d:
फलितं पुष्पितं वृक्षं देवताप्रतिमां नृपम् ॥
गजस्थं च रथस्थं च पश्यन्तं स्वं ददर्श ह ॥ 44 ॥
3.33.m:
seated on an elephant and seated on a chariot.
He saw himself looking at a fruitful, flowering tree, the image of a deity, and a king,

3.33.s:
pītavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitām ..
viśantīṃ brāhmaṇo gehaṃ paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha .. 45 ..
3.33.d:
पीतवस्त्रपरीधानां रत्नालङ्कारभूषिताम् ॥
विशन्तीं ब्राह्मणो गेहं पश्यन्तं स्वं ददर्श ह ॥ 45 ॥
3.33.m:
Clad in yellow garments, adorned with jewel ornaments,
the brāhmaṇa saw [her] entering his house.

3.33.s:
śaṃkhaṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ śvetamālāṃ muktāṃ ca candanam ..
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ratnaṃ paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha .. 46 ..
3.33.d:
शंखं च स्फटिकं श्वेतमालां मुक्तां च चन्दनम् ॥
सुवर्णं रजतं रत्नं पश्यन्तं स्वं ददर्श ह ॥ 46 ॥
3.33.m:
A conch shell, crystal, a white garland, pearls, and sandal paste,
gold, silver, and jewels he saw himself beholding.

3.33.s:
gajaṃ vṛṣaṃ ca sarpaṃ ca śvetaṃ ca śvetacāmaram ..
nīlotpalaṃ darpaṇaṃ ca bhārgavo vai dadarśa ha .. 47 ..
3.33.d:
गजं वृषं च सर्पं च श्वेतं च श्वेतचामरम् ॥
नीलोत्पलं दर्पणं च भार्गवो वै ददर्श ह ॥ 47 ॥
3.33.m:
An elephant, a bull, a serpent, white things, a white fly-whisk,
a blue lotus, and a mirror: the Bhārgava indeed saw these.

3.33.s:
rathasthaṃ navaratnāḍhyaṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ..
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ svaṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha .. 48 ..
3.33.d:
रथस्थं नवरत्नाढ्यं मालतीमाल्यभूषितम् ॥
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं स्वं भृगुः स्वप्ने ददर्श ह ॥ 48 ॥
3.33.m:
Mounted on a chariot, enriched with the nine jewels, adorned with a garland of mālatī flowers,
Bhṛgu saw himself in his dream seated upon a jewel throne.

3.33.s:
padmaśreṇīṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ dadhi lājānghṛtaṃ madhu ..
parṇacchatraṃ chatriṇaṃ ca bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha .. 49 ..
3.33.d:
पद्मश्रेणीं पूर्णकुम्भं दधि लाजान्घृतं मधु ॥
पर्णच्छत्रं छत्रिणं च भृगुः स्वप्ने ददर्श ह ॥ 49 ॥
3.33.m:
A row of lotuses, a full jar, curd, parched grain, ghee, and honey,
a leaf parasol, and an umbrella-bearer: Bhṛgu saw them in his dream.

3.33.s:
bakapaṃktiṃ haṃsapaṃktiṃ kanyāpaṃktiṃ vratānvitām ..
pūjayanto ghaṭaṃ śubhraṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha .. 3.33.50 ..
3.33.d:
बकपंक्तिं हंसपंक्तिं कन्यापंक्तिं व्रतान्विताम् ॥
पूजयन्तो घटं शुभ्रं भृगुः स्वप्ने ददर्श ह ॥ 3.33.50 ॥
3.33.m:
A row of cranes, a row of swans, a row of maidens observing vows,
worshipping a white pot: Bhṛgu saw them in his dream.

3.33.s:
maṇḍapasthaṃ dvijagaṇaṃ pūjayantaṃ haraṃ harim ..
jayo'stvityuktavantaṃ taṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha .. 51 ..
3.33.d:
मण्डपस्थं द्विजगणं पूजयन्तं हरं हरिम् ॥
जयोऽस्त्वित्युक्तवन्तं तं भृगुः स्वप्ने ददर्श ह ॥ 51 ॥
3.33.m:
A multitude of brāhmaṇas seated in a pavilion worshipping Hara and Hari,
and saying, 'May there be victory!': Bhṛgu saw them in his dream.

3.33.s:
sudhāvṛṣṭiṃ parṇavṛṣṭiṃ phalavṛṣṭiṃ ca śāśvatīm ..
puṣpacandanavṛṣṭiṃ ca bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha .. 52 ..
3.33.d:
सुधावृष्टिं पर्णवृष्टिं फलवृष्टिं च शाश्वतीम् ॥
पुष्पचन्दनवृष्टिं च भृगुः स्वप्ने ददर्श ह ॥ 52 ॥
3.33.m:
A shower of nectar, a shower of leaves, a continuous shower of fruits,
and a shower of flowers and sandal paste: Bhṛgu saw them in his dream.

3.33.s:
sadyomāṃsaṃ jīvamatsyaṃ mayūraṃ śvetakhañjanam ..
sarovaraṃ ca tīrthāni bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha .. 53 ..
3.33.d:
सद्योमांसं जीवमत्स्यं मयूरं श्वेतखञ्जनम् ॥
सरोवरं च तीर्थानि भृगुः स्वप्ने ददर्श ह ॥ 53 ॥
3.33.m:
Fresh meat, live fish, a peacock, a white wagtail,
a lake, and sacred bathing places: Bhṛgu saw them in his dream.

3.33.s:
pārāvataṃ śukaṃ cāṣaṃ śaṃkhaṃ cillaṃ ca cātakam ..
vyāghraṃ siṃhaṃ ca surabhīṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ..54..
3.33.d:
पारावतं शुकं चाषं शंखं चिल्लं च चातकम् ॥
व्याघ्रं सिंहं च सुरभीं भृगुः स्वप्ने ददर्श ह ॥54॥
3.33.m:
A pigeon, a parrot, a blue jay, a conch shell, a kite, and a cātaka bird,
a tiger, a lion, and Surabhi: Bhṛgu saw them in his dream.

3.33.s:
gorocanāṃ haridrāṃ ca śukladhānyācalaṃ varam ..
jvaladagniṃ tathā dūrvāṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ..55..
3.33.d:
गोरोचनां हरिद्रां च शुक्लधान्याचलं वरम् ॥
ज्वलदग्निं तथा दूर्वां भृगुः स्वप्ने ददर्श ह ॥55॥
3.33.m:
Yellow orpiment, turmeric, an excellent mountain of white grain,
a blazing fire, and dūrvā grass: Bhṛgu saw them in his dream.

3.33.s:
devālayasamūhaṃ ca śivaliṃgaṃ ca pūjitam ..
arcitāṃ mṛnmayīṃ śaivāṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha .. 56 ..
3.33.d:
देवालयसमूहं च शिवलिंगं च पूजितम् ॥
अर्चितां मृन्मयीं शैवां भृगुः स्वप्ने ददर्श ह ॥ 56 ॥
3.33.m:
Clusters of temples, a worshipped Śiva-linga,
and an earthen image of Śiva being worshipped: Bhṛgu saw them in his dream.

3.33.s:
yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca ..
bhṛgurdadarśa svapne ca bubhuje ca punaḥ punaḥ .. 57 ..
3.33.d:
यवगोधूमचूर्णानां भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च ॥
भृगुर्ददर्श स्वप्ने च बुभुजे च पुनः पुनः ॥ 57 ॥
3.33.m: Bhṛgu saw in his dream and ate again and again.

3.33.s:
divyavastraparīdhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ..
agamyāgamanaṃ svapne cakāra bhṛgunandanaḥ ..58..
3.33.d:
दिव्यवस्त्रपरीधाना रत्नभूषणभूषिताः ॥
अगम्यागमनं स्वप्ने चकार भृगुनन्दनः ॥58॥
3.33.m:
Clad in divine garments, adorned with jewel ornaments,
In his dream, the scion of Bhṛgu engaged in forbidden intercourse;

3.33.s:
dadarśa narttakīṃ veśyāṃ rudhiraṃ ca surāṃ papau ..
rudhirokṣitasarvāṅgaḥ svapne ca bhṛgunandanaḥ .. 59 ..
3.33.d:
ददर्श नर्त्तकीं वेश्यां रुधिरं च सुरां पपौ ॥
रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गः स्वप्ने च भृगुनन्दनः ॥ 59 ॥
3.33.m:
he saw a dancing woman, a courtesan, and he drank blood and liquor.
With all his limbs smeared with blood in the dream, the scion of Bhṛgu,

3.33.s:
pakṣiṇāṃ pītavarṇānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca nārada ..
māṃsāni bubhuje rāmo hṛṣṭaḥ svapne'ruṇodaye .. 3.33.60 ..
3.33.d:
पक्षिणां पीतवर्णानां मानुषाणां च नारद ॥
मांसानि बुभुजे रामो हृष्टः स्वप्नेऽरुणोदये ॥ 3.33.60 ॥
3.33.m:
O Nārada, ate the meat of yellow birds
and of human beings; delighted in the dream at daybreak, Rāma [awoke].

3.33.s:
akasmānnigaḍairbaddhaṃ kṣataṃ śastreṇa svaṃ punaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā ca bubudhe prātaḥ samuttasthau hariṃ smaran.. 61 ..
3.33.d:
अकस्मान्निगडैर्बद्धं क्षतं शस्त्रेण स्वं पुनः ॥
दृष्ट्वा च बुबुधे प्रातः समुत्तस्थौ हरिं स्मरन्॥ 61 ॥
3.33.m:
Suddenly seeing himself bound with chains and wounded by a weapon,
he awoke in the morning and arose, remembering Hari.

3.33.s:
atīva hṛṣṭaḥ svapnena prātaḥkṛtyaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
manasā bubudhe sarvaṃ vijeṣyāmi ripuṃ dhruvam .. 62 ..
3.33.d:
अतीव हृष्टः स्वप्नेन प्रातःकृत्यं चकार सः ॥
मनसा बुबुधे सर्वं विजेष्यामि रिपुं ध्रुवम् ॥ 62 ॥
3.33.m:
Extremely delighted by the dream, he performed his morning rituals.
In his mind he understood everything: "I will surely conquer the enemy."

3.34.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
sa prātarāhnikaṃ kṛtvā samālocya ca taiḥ saha ..
dūtaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa kārttavīryyāśramaṃ bhṛguḥ ..1..
3.34.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
स प्रातराह्निकं कृत्वा समालोच्य च तैः सह ॥
दूतं प्रस्थापयामास कार्त्तवीर्य्याश्रमं भृगुः ॥1॥

3.34.s:
sa dūtaḥśīghramāgatya vasantaṃ rājasaṃsadi ..
veṣṭitaṃ sacivaiḥ sārddhamuvāca nṛpatīśvaram .. 2 ..
3.34.d:
स दूतःशीघ्रमागत्य वसन्तं राजसंसदि ॥
वेष्टितं सचिवैः सार्द्धमुवाच नृपतीश्वरम् ॥ 2 ॥

3.34.s:
rāmadūta uvāca ..
narmmadātīrasānnidhye nyagrodhākṣayamūlake ..
sa bhṛgurbhrātṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ tatra tvaṃ gantumarhasi .. 3 ..
3.34.d:
रामदूत उवाच ॥
नर्म्मदातीरसान्निध्ये न्यग्रोधाक्षयमूलके ॥
स भृगुर्भ्रातृभिः सार्द्धं तत्र त्वं गन्तुमर्हसि ॥ 3 ॥

3.34.s:
yuddhaṃ kuru mahārāja jātibhirjñātibhiḥ saha ..
trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyati mahīmiti .. 4 ..
3.34.d:
युद्धं कुरु महाराज जातिभिर्ज्ञातिभिः सह ॥
त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां करिष्यति महीमिति ॥ 4 ॥

3.34.s:
ityuktvā rāmadūtaścāpyagacchadrāmasannidhim ..
rājā vidhāya sannāhaṃ samaraṃ gantumudyataḥ .. 5 ..
3.34.d:
इत्युक्त्वा रामदूतश्चाप्यगच्छद्रामसन्निधिम् ॥
राजा विधाय सन्नाहं समरं गन्तुमुद्यतः ॥ 5 ॥

3.34.s:
gacchantaṃ samaraṃ dṛṣṭvā prāṇeśaṃ sā manoramā ..
tameva vārayāmāsa vāsayāmāsa sannidhau .. 6 ..
3.34.d:
गच्छन्तं समरं दृष्ट्वा प्राणेशं सा मनोरमा ॥
तमेव वारयामास वासयामास सन्निधौ ॥ 6 ॥

3.34.s:
rājā manoramāṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ..
tāmuvāca sabhāmadhye vākyaṃ mānasikaṃ mune .. 7 ..
3.34.d:
राजा मनोरमां दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणः ॥
तामुवाच सभामध्ये वाक्यं मानसिकं मुने ॥ 7 ॥

3.34.s:
kārttavīryyārjuna uvāca..
māmevāhvayate kānte jamadagnisuto mahān ..
sa tiṣṭhannarmmadātīre raṇāya bhrātṛbhiḥ saha .. 8 ..
3.34.d:
कार्त्तवीर्य्यार्जुन उवाच॥
मामेवाह्वयते कान्ते जमदग्निसुतो महान् ॥
स तिष्ठन्नर्म्मदातीरे रणाय भ्रातृभिः सह ॥ 8 ॥

3.34.s:
samprāpya śaṅkarācchastraṃ mantraṃ ca kavacaṃ hareḥ .'
trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kartumicchati medinīm .. 9 ..
3.34.d:
सम्प्राप्य शङ्कराच्छस्त्रं मन्त्रं च कवचं हरेः ।'
त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां कर्तुमिच्छति मेदिनीम् ॥ 9 ॥

3.34.s:
āndolayanti me prāṇā manaḥ saṃkṣubhitaṃ muhuḥ ..
śaśvatsphurati vāmāṅgaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ svapnaṃ śṛṇu priye .. 3.34.10 ..
3.34.d:
आन्दोलयन्ति मे प्राणा मनः संक्षुभितं मुहुः ॥
शश्वत्स्फुरति वामाङ्गं दृष्टं स्वप्नं शृणु प्रिये ॥ 3.34.10 ॥

3.34.s:
tailābhyaṅgitamātmānamapaśyaṃ gardabhopari ..
auḍhapuṣpasya mālyaṃ ca bibhrataṃ raktacandanam .. 11 ..
3.34.d:
तैलाभ्यङ्गितमात्मानमपश्यं गर्दभोपरि ॥
औढपुष्पस्य माल्यं च बिभ्रतं रक्तचन्दनम् ॥ 11 ॥

3.34.s:
raktavastraparīdhānaṃ lohālaṅkārabhūṣitam ..
krīḍantaṃ ca hasantaṃ ca nirvāṇāṅgārarāśinā .. 12 ..
3.34.d:
रक्तवस्त्रपरीधानं लोहालङ्कारभूषितम् ॥
क्रीडन्तं च हसन्तं च निर्वाणाङ्गारराशिना ॥ 12 ॥

3.34.s:
bhasmācchannāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ japāpuṣpānvitāṃ sati ..
rahitaṃ candrasūryyābhyāṃ rastasandhyānvitaṃ nabhaḥ .. 13 ..
3.34.d:
भस्माच्छन्नां च पृथिवीं जपापुष्पान्वितां सति ॥
रहितं चन्द्रसूर्य्याभ्यां रस्तसन्ध्यान्वितं नभः ॥ 13 ॥

3.34.s:
muktakeśāṃ ca nṛtyantīṃ vidhavāṃ chinnanāsikām ..
raktavastraparīdhānāmapaśyaṃ cāṭṭahāsinīm .. 14 ..
3.34.d:
मुक्तकेशां च नृत्यन्तीं विधवां छिन्ननासिकाम् ॥
रक्तवस्त्रपरीधानामपश्यं चाट्टहासिनीम् ॥ 14 ॥

3.34.s:
saśarāmagnirahitāṃ citāṃ bhasmasamanvitām ..
bhasmavṛṣṭimasṛgvṛṣṭimagnivṛṣṭimapīśvari .. 19 ..
3.34.d:
सशरामग्निरहितां चितां भस्मसमन्विताम् ॥
भस्मवृष्टिमसृग्वृष्टिमग्निवृष्टिमपीश्वरि ॥ 19 ॥

3.34.s:
pakva tālaphalākīrṇāṃ pṛthivīmasthisaṃyutām..
apaśyaṃ karparaughaṃ ca chinnakeśanakhānvitam ..16..
3.34.d:
पक्व तालफलाकीर्णां पृथिवीमस्थिसंयुताम्॥
अपश्यं कर्परौघं च छिन्नकेशनखान्वितम् ॥16॥

3.34.s:
parvataṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca rāśībhūtaṃ kapardakam..
cūrṇānāṃ caiva tailānāmadṛśaṃ kandaraṃ niśi ..17..
3.34.d:
पर्वतं लवणानां च राशीभूतं कपर्दकम्॥
चूर्णानां चैव तैलानामदृशं कन्दरं निशि ॥17॥

3.34.s:
adṛśaṃ puṣpitaṃ vṛkṣamaśokakaravīrayoḥ ..
tālavṛkṣaṃ ca phalitaṃ tatra caiva patatphalam .. 18 ...
3.34.d:
अदृशं पुष्पितं वृक्षमशोककरवीरयोः ॥
तालवृक्षं च फलितं तत्र चैव पतत्फलम् ॥ 18 ॥।

3.34.s:
svakarātpūrṇakalaśaḥ papāta ca babhañja ca ..
ityapaśyaṃ ca gaganātsampataccandramaṇḍalam ..19..
3.34.d:
स्वकरात्पूर्णकलशः पपात च बभञ्ज च ॥
इत्यपश्यं च गगनात्सम्पतच्चन्द्रमण्डलम् ॥19॥

3.34.s:
apaśyamambarātsūryyamaṇḍalaṃ samampatadbhuvi ..
ulkāpātaṃ dhūmaketuṃ grahaṇaṃ candrasūryyayoḥ .. 3.34.20 ..
3.34.d:
अपश्यमम्बरात्सूर्य्यमण्डलं समम्पतद्भुवि ॥
उल्कापातं धूमकेतुं ग्रहणं चन्द्रसूर्य्ययोः ॥ 3.34.20 ॥

3.34.s:
vikṛtākārapuruṣaṃ vikaṭāsyaṃ digambaram ..
āgacchantaṃ cāgratastamapaśyaṃ ca bhayānakam .. 21 ..
3.34.d:
विकृताकारपुरुषं विकटास्यं दिगम्बरम् ॥
आगच्छन्तं चाग्रतस्तमपश्यं च भयानकम् ॥ 21 ॥

3.34.s:
bālā dvādaśāvarṣīyā vastrabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ..
saṃruṣṭā yāti madgehādityapaśyamahaṃ niśi .. 22 ..
3.34.d:
बाला द्वादशावर्षीया वस्त्रभूषणभूषिता ॥
संरुष्टा याति मद्गेहादित्यपश्यमहं निशि ॥ 22 ॥
3.34.m: departing angrily from my house—this I saw in the night.

3.34.s:
ājñāṃ tvaṃ dehi rājendra tvadgehādyāmi kānanam ..
vadasi tvaṃ māmiti ca niśyapaśyamahaṃ śucā .. 23 ..
3.34.d:
आज्ञां त्वं देहि राजेन्द्र त्वद्गेहाद्यामि काननम् ॥
वदसि त्वं मामिति च निश्यपश्यमहं शुचा ॥ 23 ॥
3.34.m:
"Give me permission, O best of kings; I am going from your house to the forest"—
so you spoke to me; this I saw at night in sorrow.

3.34.s:
ruṣṭo vipro māṃ śapate saṃnyāsī ca tathā guruḥ ..
bhittau puttalikāścitrā nṛtyantīśca dadarśa ha .. 24 ..
3.34.d:
रुष्टो विप्रो मां शपते संन्यासी च तथा गुरुः ॥
भित्तौ पुत्तलिकाश्चित्रा नृत्यन्तीश्च ददर्श ह ॥ 24 ॥
3.34.m:
An angry brāhmaṇa curses me, as does an ascetic and my teacher.
And I saw the painted dolls on the wall dancing!

3.34.s:
cañcalānāṃ ca gṛdhrāṇāṃ kākānāṃ nikaraiḥ sadā ..
pīḍitaṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ ca svamapaśyamahaṃ niśi .. 25 ..
3.34.d:
चञ्चलानां च गृध्राणां काकानां निकरैः सदा ॥
पीडितं महिषाणां च स्वमपश्यमहं निशि ॥ 25 ॥
3.34.m:
And constantly by flocks of restless vultures and crows,
and by buffaloes, I saw myself tormented at night.

3.34.s:
pīḍitaṃ tailayantreṇa bhrāmitaṃ tailakāriṇā ..
digambarānpāśahastānapaśyamahamīśvari .. 26 ..
3.34.d:
पीडितं तैलयन्त्रेण भ्रामितं तैलकारिणा ॥
दिगम्बरान्पाशहस्तानपश्यमहमीश्वरि ॥ 26 ॥
3.34.m:
Crushed in an oil-press, revolved by an oil-presser,
and space-clad men with nooses in hand, O sovereign lady, did I see.

3.34.s:
nṛtyanti gāyakāḥ sarve gānaṃ gāyanti me gṛhe ..
vivāhaṃ paramānandamityapaśyamahaṃ niśi .. 27 ..
3.34.d:
नृत्यन्ति गायकाः सर्वे गानं गायन्ति मे गृहे ॥
विवाहं परमानन्दमित्यपश्यमहं निशि ॥ 27 ॥
3.34.m:
All the musicians are dancing and singing songs in my house,
and a marriage, a supreme joy—such did I see at night.

3.34.s:
ramaṇaṃ kurvato lokānkeśākeśi ca kurvataḥ ..
adṛśaṃ samaraṃ rātrau kākānāṃ ca śunāmapi .. 28 ..
3.34.d:
रमणं कुर्वतो लोकान्केशाकेशि च कुर्वतः ॥
अदृशं समरं रात्रौ काकानां च शुनामपि ॥ 28 ॥
3.34.m:
People making love and tearing each other's hair,
and a fight between crows and dogs did I see at night.

3.34.s:
moṭakāni ca piṇḍāni śmaśānaṃ śavasaṃyutam ..
raktavastraṃ śuklavastramapaśyaṃ niśi kāmini .. 29 ..
3.34.d:
मोटकानि च पिण्डानि श्मशानं शवसंयुतम् ॥
रक्तवस्त्रं शुक्लवस्त्रमपश्यं निशि कामिनि ॥ 29 ॥
3.34.m:
Presents of sweetmeats, funeral balls of rice, a cremation ground with corpses,
red garments and white garments I saw at night, O lovely woman.

3.34.s:
kṛṣṇāmbarā kṛṣṇavarṇā nagnā vai muktakeśinī..
vidhavā''śliṣyati ca māmapaśyaṃ niśi śobhane .. .. 3.34.30 ..
3.34.d:
कृष्णाम्बरा कृष्णवर्णा नग्ना वै मुक्तकेशिनी॥
विधवा'ऽश्लिष्यति च मामपश्यं निशि शोभने ॥ ॥ 3.34.30 ॥
3.34.m:
Clad in black, dark-complexioned, naked, with dishevelled hair,
a widow embraces me—this I saw at night, O fair one.

3.34.s:
nāpito muṇḍate muṇḍaṃ śmaśruśreṇīṃ ca me priye ..
vakṣaḥsthalaṃ ca nakharamityapaśyamahaṃ niśi .. 31 ..
3.34.d:
नापितो मुण्डते मुण्डं श्मश्रुश्रेणीं च मे प्रिये ॥
वक्षःस्थलं च नखरमित्यपश्यमहं निशि ॥ 31 ॥
3.34.m:
A barber shaves my head and the line of my beard, my dear,
and my chest and nails—thus did I see at night.

3.34.s:
pādukā carmarajjūnāmapaśyaṃ rāśimulbaṇam ..
cakraṃ bhramantaṃ bhūmau ca kulālasyeti sundari .. 32 ..
3.34.d:
पादुका चर्मरज्जूनामपश्यं राशिमुल्बणम् ॥
चक्रं भ्रमन्तं भूमौ च कुलालस्येति सुन्दरि ॥ 32 ॥
3.34.m:
A huge heap of leather shoes and ropes,
and a potter's wheel spinning on the ground did I see, O beautiful woman.

3.34.s:
vātyayā ghūrṇamānaṃ ca śuṣkavṛkṣaṃ tamutthitam ..
pūrṇamānaṃ kabandhaṃ vai cāpaśyaṃ niśi suvrate .. 33 ..
3.34.d:
वात्यया घूर्णमानं च शुष्कवृक्षं तमुत्थितम् ॥
पूर्णमानं कबन्धं वै चापश्यं निशि सुव्रते ॥ 33 ॥
3.34.m:
Whirling in a whirlwind, a standing dry tree,
and a falling headless trunk did I see at night, O faithful wife.

3.34.s:
grathitāṃ muṇḍamālāṃ ca cūrṇamānāṃ ca vātyayā ..
atīva ghoradaśanāmapyapaśyamahaṃ vare .. 34 ..
3.34.d:
ग्रथितां मुण्डमालां च चूर्णमानां च वात्यया ॥
अतीव घोरदशनामप्यपश्यमहं वरे ॥ 34 ॥
3.34.m:
A strung garland of severed heads, shattered by a whirlwind,
and one with exceedingly terrifying fangs did I see, O excellent woman.

3.34.s:
bhūtapretā muktakeśā vamantaśva hutāśanam ..
māṃ bhīṣayanti satatamityapaśyamahaṃ niśi .. 35 ..
3.34.d:
भूतप्रेता मुक्तकेशा वमन्तश्व हुताशनम् ॥
मां भीषयन्ति सततमित्यपश्यमहं निशि ॥ 35 ॥
3.34.m:
Ghosts and spirits with dishevelled hair, vomiting fire,
constantly terrifying me—thus did I see at night.

3.34.s:
dagdhajīvaṃ dagdhavṛkṣaṃ vyādhigrastaṃ naraṃ param ..
aṅgahīnaṃ ca vṛṣalamapyapaśyamahaṃ niśi .. 36 ..
3.34.d:
दग्धजीवं दग्धवृक्षं व्याधिग्रस्तं नरं परम् ॥
अङ्गहीनं च वृषलमप्यपश्यमहं निशि ॥ 36 ॥
3.34.m:
A burnt living creature, a burnt tree, a man seized by disease,
and a mutilated Śūdra did I see at night.

3.34.s:
gehaparvatavṛkṣāṇāṃ sahasā patanaṃ param ..
muhurmuhurvajrapātamapyapaśyamahaṃ niśi .. 37 ..
3.34.d:
गेहपर्वतवृक्षाणां सहसा पतनं परम् ॥
मुहुर्मुहुर्वज्रपातमप्यपश्यमहं निशि ॥ 37 ॥
3.34.m:
The sudden great collapse of houses, mountains, and trees,
and repeatedly the fall of thunderbolts did I see at night.

3.34.s:
kukkurāṇāṃ śṛgālānāṃ rodanaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
gṛhe gṛhe ca niyatamapaśyaṃ sarvato niśi .. 38 ..
3.34.d:
कुक्कुराणां शृगालानां रोदनं च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
गृहे गृहे च नियतमपश्यं सर्वतो निशि ॥ 38 ॥
3.34.m:
And the weeping of dogs and jackals again and again
in house after house constantly on every side I saw at night.

3.34.s:
adhaśśirastūrddhvapādaṃ muktakeśaṃ digambaram ..
bhūmau bhramantaṃ gacchantaṃ cāpyapaśyamahaṃ naram .. 39 ..
3.34.d:
अधश्शिरस्तूर्द्ध्वपादं मुक्तकेशं दिगम्बरम् ॥
भूमौ भ्रमन्तं गच्छन्तं चाप्यपश्यमहं नरम् ॥ 39 ॥
3.34.m:
Head downward, feet upward, hair dishevelled, clad in space,
wandering and walking on the earth—such a man did I see.

3.34.s:
vikṛtākāraśabdaṃ ca grāmādau deva rodanam ..
prātaḥ śrutvaivāvabuddhaḥ ka upāyo vadādhunā .. 3.34.40 ..
3.34.d:
विकृताकारशब्दं च ग्रामादौ देव रोदनम् ॥
प्रातः श्रुत्वैवावबुद्धः क उपायो वदाधुना ॥ 3.34.40 ॥
3.34.m:
Hearing distorted sounds and weeping in the village and elsewhere, O queen,
I woke at dawn. Speak now: what is the remedy?

3.34.s:
nṛpatervacanaṃ śrutvā hṛdayena vidūyatā ..
sagadgadaṃ ca rudatī tamuvāca nṛpeśvaram .. 41 ..
3.34.d:
नृपतेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा हृदयेन विदूयता ॥
सगद्गदं च रुदती तमुवाच नृपेश्वरम् ॥ 41 ॥
3.34.m:
Hearing the king's words, her heart aching,
weeping with a choked voice, she spoke to the lord of kings.

3.34.s:
manoramovāca ..
he nātha ramaṇaśreṣṭha śreṣṭha sarvamahībhṛtām ..
prāṇātireka prāṇeśa śṛṇu vākyaṃ śubhāvaham ..42..
3.34.d:
मनोरमोवाच ॥
हे नाथ रमणश्रेष्ठ श्रेष्ठ सर्वमहीभृताम् ॥
प्राणातिरेक प्राणेश शृणु वाक्यं शुभावहम् ॥42॥
3.34.m:
O lord, best of lovers, best of all earth-rulers,
dearer than life, lord of my life, listen to beneficial words.

3.34.s:
nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavāñjāmadagnyo mahābalī ..
sṛṣṭisaṃharturīśasya śiṣyo'yaṃ jagataḥ prabhoḥ .. 43 ..
3.34.d:
नारायणांशो भगवाञ्जामदग्न्यो महाबली ॥
सृष्टिसंहर्तुरीशस्य शिष्योऽयं जगतः प्रभोः ॥ 43 ॥
3.34.m:
The blessed descendant of Jamadagni, very mighty, is an portion of Nārāyaṇa;
he is the disciple of the Lord, the dissolver of creation, the master of the universe.

3.34.s:
triḥsaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyāmi mahīmiti ..
pratijñā yasya rāmasya tena sārddhaṃ raṇaṃ tyaja .. 44 ..
3.34.d:
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां करिष्यामि महीमिति ॥
प्रतिज्ञा यस्य रामस्य तेन सार्द्धं रणं त्यज ॥ 44 ॥
3.34.m:
"Three times seven times I shall make the earth bereft of kings"—
such is the vow of this Rāma. Abandon battle with him!

3.34.s:
pāpinaṃ rāvaṇaṃ jitvā śūraṃ tvamapi manyase ..
sa tvayā na jito nātha svapāpena parājitaḥ .. 45 ..
3.34.d:
पापिनं रावणं जित्वा शूरं त्वमपि मन्यसे ॥
स त्वया न जितो नाथ स्वपापेन पराजितः ॥ 45 ॥
3.34.m:
Having conquered the sinful Rāvaṇa, you consider yourself a hero.
He was not defeated by you, my lord; he was defeated by his own sin.

3.34.s:
yo na rakṣati dharmmaṃ ca tasya ko rakṣitā bhuvi ..
sa naśyati svayaṃ mūḍho jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ .. 46 ..
3.34.d:
यो न रक्षति धर्म्मं च तस्य को रक्षिता भुवि ॥
स नश्यति स्वयं मूढो जीवन्नपि मृतो हि सः ॥ 46 ॥
3.34.m:
Who on earth will protect one who does not protect dharma?
That fool perishes of himself; though living, he is indeed dead.

3.34.s:
śubhāśubhasya satataṃ sākṣī dharmmasya karmaṇaḥ ..
ātmārāmaḥ sthitaḥ svānto mūḍhastvaṃ nahi paśyasi ..47..
3.34.d:
शुभाशुभस्य सततं साक्षी धर्म्मस्य कर्मणः ॥
आत्मारामः स्थितः स्वान्तो मूढस्त्वं नहि पश्यसि ॥47॥
3.34.m:
The witness of good and evil, of dharma and action,
delighting in the self, resides within; foolish as you are, you do not see Him.

3.34.s:
putradārādikaṃ yadyatsarvaiśvaryyaṃ sudharmiṇām ..
jalabudbudavatsarvamanityaṃ naśvaraṃ nṛpa ..48..
3.34.d:
पुत्रदारादिकं यद्यत्सर्वैश्वर्य्यं सुधर्मिणाम् ॥
जलबुद्बुदवत्सर्वमनित्यं नश्वरं नृप ॥48॥
3.34.m:
Sons, wives, and whatever else—all the sovereignty of the truly righteous—
is all impermanent and perishable like a bubble in water, O king.

3.34.s:
saṃsāraṃ svapnasadṛśaṃ matvā santo'tra bhārate..
dhyāyanti satataṃ dharmmaṃ tapaḥ kurvanti bhaktitaḥ .. 49 ..
3.34.d:
संसारं स्वप्नसदृशं मत्वा सन्तोऽत्र भारते॥
ध्यायन्ति सततं धर्म्मं तपः कुर्वन्ति भक्तितः ॥ 49 ॥
3.34.m:
Regarding worldly existence as like a dream, the virtuous here in Bhārata
constantly meditate on dharma and perform austerity with devotion.

3.34.s:
dattena dattaṃ yajjñānaṃ tatsarvaṃ vismṛtaṃ tvayā ..
asti cedviprahiṃsāyāṃ kubuddhe tvanmanaḥ katham .. 3.34.50 ..
3.34.d:
दत्तेन दत्तं यज्ज्ञानं तत्सर्वं विस्मृतं त्वया ॥
अस्ति चेद्विप्रहिंसायां कुबुद्धे त्वन्मनः कथम् ॥ 3.34.50 ॥
3.34.m:
The knowledge that was imparted by Datta has all been forgotten by you.
If it still remains, how has your mind turned to harming a Brahmin, O wicked-minded one?

3.34.s:
sukhārthe mṛgayāṃ gatvā tatropoṣya dvijāśrame ..
bhuktvā miṣṭamapūrvaṃ ca hato vipro nirarthakam .. 51 ..
3.34.d:
सुखार्थे मृगयां गत्वा तत्रोपोष्य द्विजाश्रमे ॥
भुक्त्वा मिष्टमपूर्वं च हतो विप्रो निरर्थकम् ॥ 51 ॥
3.34.m:
Having gone hunting for pleasure and stayed there in the Brahmin's hermitage,
having eaten sweet and wondrous food, you killed the Brahmin for no reason.

3.34.s:
guru viprasurāṇāṃ ca yaḥ karoti parābhavam ..
abhīṣṭadevastaṃ ruṣṭo vipattistasya sannidhau .. 52 ..
3.34.d:
गुरु विप्रसुराणां च यः करोति पराभवम् ॥
अभीष्टदेवस्तं रुष्टो विपत्तिस्तस्य सन्निधौ ॥ 52 ॥
3.34.m:
He who brings humiliation upon a guru, a Brahmin, or the gods—
his chosen deity is angered against him, and calamity is at hand for him.

3.34.s:
smaraṇaṃ kuru rājendra dattātreyapadāmbujam ..
gurau bhaktiśca sarveṣāṃ sarvavighnavināśinī .. 53 ..
3.34.d:
स्मरणं कुरु राजेन्द्र दत्तात्रेयपदाम्बुजम् ॥
गुरौ भक्तिश्च सर्वेषां सर्वविघ्नविनाशिनी ॥ 53 ॥
3.34.m:
Remember the lotus feet of Dattātreya, O best of kings!
Devotion to the guru destroys all obstacles for all people.

3.34.s:
gurudevaṃ samabhyarcya taṃ bhṛguṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ..
vipre deve prasanne ca kṣattriyāṇāṃ nahi kṣatiḥ .. 54 ..
3.34.d:
गुरुदेवं समभ्यर्च्य तं भृगुं शरणं व्रज ॥
विप्रे देवे प्रसन्ने च क्षत्त्रियाणां नहि क्षतिः ॥ 54 ॥
3.34.m:
Worship the guru, and go to that Bhṛgu for refuge.
When the VIPRA and the deity are pleased, there is no harm to Kṣatriyas.

3.34.s:
viprasya kiṃkaro bhūpo vaiśyo bhūpasya bhūmipa ..
sarveṣāṃ kiṅkarāḥ śūdrā brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ .. 59 ..
3.34.d:
विप्रस्य किंकरो भूपो वैश्यो भूपस्य भूमिप ॥
सर्वेषां किङ्कराः शूद्रा ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषतः ॥ 59 ॥
3.34.m:
The king is the servant of the VIPRA, and the Vaiśya is [the servant] of the king, O ruler of the earth;
Śūdras are the servants of all, especially of the Brāhmaṇa.

3.34.s:
ayaśaḥ śaraṇaṃ śaśvatkṣatriyasya ca kṣatriye ..
mahadyaśastaccharaṇaṃ gurudevadvijeṣu ca .. 96 ..
brāhmaṇaṃ bhaja rājendra garīyāṃsaṃ surādapi ..
brāhmaṇe parituṣṭe ca santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ..57..
ityevamuktvā rājendraṃ kroḍe kṛtvā mahāsatī..
muhurmuhurmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vilalāpa ruroda ca ..58..
kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha mahārāja punarevamuvāca sā ..
snānaṃ kuru mahārāja bhojayiṣyāmi vāñchitam .. 59 ..
candanāgurukastūrīkarpūraiḥ kuṃkumairyutam ..
anulepaṃ kariṣyāmi sarvāṃge tava sundara ..3.34.60..
kṣaṇaṃ siṃhāsane tiṣṭha kṣaṇaṃ vakṣasi me prabho..
sabhāyāṃ puṣparacite talpe paśyāmi śobhanam .. 61 ..
śataputrādhikaḥ premṇā satīnāṃ vai patirnṛpa ..
nirūpito bhagavatā vedeṣu hariṇā svayam .. 62 ..
manorastavacaḥ śrutvā rājā paramapaṇḍitaḥ ..
bodhayāmāsa tāṃ rājñīṃ dadau pratyuttaraṃ punaḥ .. 63 ..
3.34.d:
अयशः शरणं शश्वत्क्षत्रियस्य च क्षत्रिये ॥
महद्यशस्तच्छरणं गुरुदेवद्विजेषु च ॥ 96 ॥
ब्राह्मणं भज राजेन्द्र गरीयांसं सुरादपि ॥
ब्राह्मणे परितुष्टे च सन्तुष्टाः सर्वदेवताः॥57॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजेन्द्रं क्रोडे कृत्वा महासती॥
मुहुर्मुहुर्मुखं दृष्ट्वा विललाप रुरोद च ॥58॥
क्षणं तिष्ठ महाराज पुनरेवमुवाच सा ॥
स्नानं कुरु महाराज भोजयिष्यामि वाञ्छितम् ॥ 59 ॥
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकर्पूरैः कुंकुमैर्युतम् ॥
अनुलेपं करिष्यामि सर्वांगे तव सुन्दर ॥3.34.60॥
क्षणं सिंहासने तिष्ठ क्षणं वक्षसि मे प्रभो॥
सभायां पुष्परचिते तल्पे पश्यामि शोभनम् ॥ 61 ॥
शतपुत्राधिकः प्रेम्णा सतीनां वै पतिर्नृप ॥
निरूपितो भगवता वेदेषु हरिणा स्वयम् ॥ 62 ॥
मनोरस्तवचः श्रुत्वा राजा परमपण्डितः ॥
बोधयामास तां राज्ञीं ददौ प्रत्युत्तरं पुनः ॥ 63 ॥
3.34.m:
Disgrace is perpetual refuge of a Kṣatriya with a Kṣatriya;
great fame is that refuge taken in the guru, the deity, and the twice-born.
Worship the Brāhmaṇa, O king of kings, who is greater even than a god.
When the Brāhmaṇa is thoroughly pleased, all deities are satisfied."
Having spoken thus to the king of kings, taking [him] on her lap, the greatly virtuous woman,
looking at his face again and again, lamented and wept.
"Stay a moment, great king," she spoke thus once more:
"Take a bath, great king; I will feed [you] with what is desired.
With sandalwood, agallochum, musk, camphor, and saffron combined,
I shall apply an ointment all over your body, O handsome one!
Stay for a moment on the throne, stay for a moment upon my breast, O lord!
Let me behold you beautiful in the assembly upon a bed fashioned with flowers.
A husband is dearer than a hundred sons to virtuous women by love, O king;
so it has been determined in the Vedas by the Lord Hari himself."
Having heard the words of Manoramā, the exceptionally wise king
enlightened that queen, and in return gave an answer:

3.34.s:
kārttavīryyārjuna uvāca ..
śṛṇu kānte pravakṣyāmi śrutaṃ sarvaṃ tvayeritam ..
śokārtānāṃ ca vacanaṃ na praśaṃsyaṃ sabhāsu ca .. 64 ..
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaḥ kalahaḥ prītireva ca ..
karma bhogārhakālena sarvaṃ bhavati sundari .. 65 ..
kālo dadāti rājatvaṃ kālo mṛtyuṃ punarbhavam ..
kālaḥ sṛjati saṃsāraṃ kālaḥ saṃharate punaḥ .. 66 ..
karoti pālanaṃ kālaḥ kālarūpī janārdanaḥ ..
kālasya kālaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo vidhāturvidhireva ca .. 67 ..
saṃhartturvā'pi saṃharttā pātuḥ pātā ca karmakṛt ..
sa karmaṇāṃ karmarūpī dadāti tapasāṃ phalam ..
kaḥ kena hanyate jantuḥ karmaṇā vai vinā sati.. ' .. 68 ..
sraṣṭā sṛjati sṛṣṭiṃ ca saṃharttā saṃharetpunaḥ ..
pātā pāti ca bhūtāni yasyājñāṃ paripālayet .. 69 ..
3.34.d:
कार्त्तवीर्य्यार्जुन उवाच ॥
शृणु कान्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि श्रुतं सर्वं त्वयेरितम् ॥
शोकार्तानां च वचनं न प्रशंस्यं सभासु च ॥ 64 ॥
सुखं दुःखं भयं शोकः कलहः प्रीतिरेव च ॥
कर्म भोगार्हकालेन सर्वं भवति सुन्दरि ॥ 65 ॥
कालो ददाति राजत्वं कालो मृत्युं पुनर्भवम् ॥
कालः सृजति संसारं कालः संहरते पुनः ॥ 66 ॥
करोति पालनं कालः कालरूपी जनार्दनः ॥
कालस्य कालः श्रीकृष्णो विधातुर्विधिरेव च ॥ 67 ॥
संहर्त्तुर्वाऽपि संहर्त्ता पातुः पाता च कर्मकृत् ॥
स कर्मणां कर्मरूपी ददाति तपसां फलम् ॥
कः केन हन्यते जन्तुः कर्मणा वै विना सति॥ ' ॥ 68 ॥
स्रष्टा सृजति सृष्टिं च संहर्त्ता संहरेत्पुनः ॥
पाता पाति च भूतानि यस्याज्ञां परिपालयेत् ॥ 69 ॥
3.34.m:
"Listen, beloved, I shall speak; everything spoken by you has been heard.
The speech of those afflicted by grief is not commendable in assemblies.
Pleasure, pain, fear, sorrow, conflict, and indeed affection—
everything happens through time that brings the experiencing of karma, O beautiful woman.
Time grants kingship; time gives death and rebirth.
Time creates the world; time destroys it once again.
Time maintains [it]; Janārdana is the embodiment of time.
Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the time of time, and the fate of the creator.
He is the destroyer of the destroyer, the protector of the protector, and the doer of deeds.
He, in the form of action, gives the fruit of actions and of austerities.
What living being is slain by whom, O virtuous woman, without [its own] karma?
The creator creates creation, and the destroyer destroys it again,
and the protector protects beings, obeying whose command;

3.34.s:
yasyājñayā vāti vātaḥ santataṃ bhayavihvalaḥ ..
śaśvatsañcarate mṛtyuḥ sūryyastapati santatam .. 3.34.70 ..
varṣatīndro dahatyagniḥ kālo bhramati bhītavat ..
tiṣṭhanti sthāvarāḥ sarve caranti satataṃ carāḥ .. 71 ..
vṛkṣāśca puṣpitāḥ kāle phalitaḥ pallavānvitāḥ ..
śuṣyanti kālataḥ kāle varddhante ca tadājñayā ..72..
āvirbhūtā tirobhūtā sṛṣṭireva tadājñayā ..
tasyājñayā bhavetsarvaṃ na kiñcitsvecchayā nṛṇām .. .. 73 ..
nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavāñjāmadagnyo mahābalaḥ ..
trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyati mahīmiti.. 74 ..
pratijñā viphalā tasya na bhavettu kadācana ..
niścitaṃ tasya vadhyo'hamiti jānāmi suvrate .. 75 ..
jñātvā sarvaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ yāmi tatkatham ..
pratiṣṭhitānāṃ cākīrttirmaraṇādatiricyate .. 76 ..
3.34.d:
यस्याज्ञया वाति वातः सन्ततं भयविह्वलः ॥
शश्वत्सञ्चरते मृत्युः सूर्य्यस्तपति सन्ततम् ॥ 3.34.70 ॥
वर्षतीन्द्रो दहत्यग्निः कालो भ्रमति भीतवत् ॥
तिष्ठन्ति स्थावराः सर्वे चरन्ति सततं चराः ॥ 71 ॥
वृक्षाश्च पुष्पिताः काले फलितः पल्लवान्विताः ॥
शुष्यन्ति कालतः काले वर्द्धन्ते च तदाज्ञया ॥72॥
आविर्भूता तिरोभूता सृष्टिरेव तदाज्ञया ॥
तस्याज्ञया भवेत्सर्वं न किञ्चित्स्वेच्छया नृणाम् ॥ ॥ 73 ॥
नारायणांशो भगवाञ्जामदग्न्यो महाबलः ॥
त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां करिष्यति महीमिति॥ 74 ॥
प्रतिज्ञा विफला तस्य न भवेत्तु कदाचन ॥
निश्चितं तस्य वध्योऽहमिति जानामि सुव्रते ॥ 75 ॥
ज्ञात्वा सर्वं भविष्यं च शरणं यामि तत्कथम् ॥
प्रतिष्ठितानां चाकीर्त्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते ॥ 76 ॥

3.34.s:
ityevamuktvā rājendraḥ samaraṃ gantumudyataḥ ..
vādyaṃ ca vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam .. 77 ..
śatakoṭirnṛpāṇāṃ ca gajendrāṇāṃ trilakṣakam ..
akṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatakaṃ mahābalaparākramam .. 78 ..
aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca padātīnāṃ tathaiva ca ..
asaṃkhyakaṃ rathānāṃ ca gṛhītvā gantumudyataḥ .. 79 ..
babhūva stimitā sādhvī dṛṣṭvā taṃ gamanonmukham .
dhṛtavantaṃ ca sannāhamakṣayaṃ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ .. 3.34.80 ..
krīḍāgāre kṣaṇaṃ tasthau kṛtvā kāntaṃ svavakṣasi ..
paśyantī tanmukhāmbhojaṃ cucumba ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 81 ..
3.34.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजेन्द्रः समरं गन्तुमुद्यतः ॥
वाद्यं च वादयामास कारयामास मंगलम् ॥ 77 ॥
शतकोटिर्नृपाणां च गजेन्द्राणां त्रिलक्षकम् ॥
अक्षौहिणीनां शतकं महाबलपराक्रमम् ॥ 78 ॥
अश्वानां च गजानां च पदातीनां तथैव च ॥
असंख्यकं रथानां च गृहीत्वा गन्तुमुद्यतः ॥ 79 ॥
बभूव स्तिमिता साध्वी दृष्ट्वा तं गमनोन्मुखम् ।
धृतवन्तं च सन्नाहमक्षयं सशरं धनुः ॥ 3.34.80 ॥
क्रीडागारे क्षणं तस्थौ कृत्वा कान्तं स्ववक्षसि ॥
पश्यन्ती तन्मुखाम्भोजं चुचुम्ब च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥ 81 ॥
3.34.m:
Having spoken thus, the king of kings prepared to march to battle;
he had musical instruments sounded and caused auspicious rites to be performed.
A hundred crores of kings, three hundred thousand chief elephants,
a hundred akṣauhiṇīs endowed with great might and valour,
and likewise an innumerable host of horses, of elephants,
of foot-soldiers, and of chariots—taking these, he set out to go.
Seeing him eager to depart, having put on his armour and holding his imperishable bow with arrows, the virtuous woman was petrified.
She stayed for a moment in the bedchamber, holding her beloved to her breast;
gazing upon his lotus-face, she kissed him again and again.

3.35.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
manoramā prāṇanāthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ..
bhaviṣyaṃ manasā cakre yadyatsvāmimukhācchutam .. 1 ..
3.35.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
मनोरमा प्राणनाथं क्षणं कृत्वा स्ववक्षसि ॥
भविष्यं मनसा चक्रे यद्यत्स्वामिमुखाच्छुतम् ॥ 1 ॥
3.35.m:
Nārāyaṇa said:
Drawing the lord of her life to her breast for a moment, Manoramā
reflected in her mind upon the future, whatever she had heard from her husband's mouth. (1)
Bringing her sons, relatives, and her servants before her,
she remembered the feet of Hari and considered, O sage, that it would prove true. (2)
Piercing the six cakras by yoga, establishing the breath in the crown of the head,
in the thousand-petalled lotus situated in the brahmarandhra, (3)
withdrawing her inner mind from sense-objects which resemble water bubbles,
establishing and binding the restless [mind] with knowledge in the partless Brahman, (4)
renouncing two-fold karma completely to put an end to rebirth,
she cast off her life-breaths there, but not her beloved who was dearer than life. (5)
Seeing her dead, that king wailed and wept;
casting off his armour and taking her to his chest, he said to her: (6)
The king said:
"Rise up, Manoramā! I shall not go to the battlefield.
Be conscious and look at me who am lamenting again and again! (7)
Rise up, Manoramā! Go home together with me.
I will not wage war with the Bhṛgu, O spirited woman! (8)
Rise up, Manoramā! Go to Śrīśaila, O beautiful one;
there I shall disport together with you as before. (9)
Rise up, Manoramā! Go to the Godāvarī, O beloved;
I shall play in the water with you as before. (10)
Rise up, Manoramā! Go to Nandana, O beautiful one;
on the bank of the Puṣpabhadrā river I shall sport in solitude. (11)
Rise up, Manoramā! Go to the Malaya mountain, O beautiful one;
with you I will delight there in the sandalwood grove, (12)
made fragrant by cool, perfumed wind,
filled with the humming of bees, and frequented by the calls of male cuckoos. (13)
Apply the ointment of sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron;
look at me whose whole body is sprinkled with sandalwood, O smiling, virtuous woman! (14)
Utter words sweet like nectar, O beloved!"

3.35.s:
putrāṃśca purataḥ hṛtvā bāndhavāṃśca svakiṃkarān ..
sasmāra sā haripadaṃ mene satyaṃ bhavenmune..2..
3.35.d:
पुत्रांश्च पुरतः हृत्वा बान्धवांश्च स्वकिंकरान् ॥
सस्मार सा हरिपदं मेने सत्यं भवेन्मुने॥2॥

3.35.s:
yogena bhittvā ṣaṭcakraṃ vāyuṃ saṃsthāpya mūrddhani ..
brahmarandhrasthakamale sahasradalasaṃyute .. 3 ..
3.35.d:
योगेन भित्त्वा षट्चक्रं वायुं संस्थाप्य मूर्द्धनि ॥
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रस्थकमले सहस्रदलसंयुते ॥ 3 ॥

3.35.s:
svāntamākṛṣya viṣayājjalabudbudasannibhāt ..
saṃsthāpya baddhvā jñānena lolaṃ brahmaṇi niṣkale .. 4 ..
3.35.d:
स्वान्तमाकृष्य विषयाज्जलबुद्बुदसन्निभात् ॥
संस्थाप्य बद्ध्वा ज्ञानेन लोलं ब्रह्मणि निष्कले ॥ 4 ॥

3.35.s:
dvividhaṃ karma saṃnyasya nirmūlamapunarbhavam ..
tatra prāṇāṃśca tatyāja na ca prāṇādhikaṃ priyam .. 5 ..
3.35.d:
द्विविधं कर्म संन्यस्य निर्मूलमपुनर्भवम् ॥
तत्र प्राणांश्च तत्याज न च प्राणाधिकं प्रियम् ॥ 5 ॥

3.35.s:
sa rājā tāṃ mṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā vilalāpa ruroda ca ..
sannāhaṃ saṃparityajya kṛtvā vakṣasyuvāca tām ..6..
3.35.d:
स राजा तां मृतां दृष्ट्वा विललाप रुरोद च ॥
सन्नाहं संपरित्यज्य कृत्वा वक्षस्युवाच ताम् ॥6॥

3.35.s:
rājovāca ..
manorame samuttiṣṭha na yāsyāmi raṇājiram ..
sacetanā māṃ paśyeti vilapantaṃ muhumurhuḥ .. 7 ..
3.35.d:
राजोवाच ॥
मनोरमे समुत्तिष्ठ न यास्यामि रणाजिरम् ॥
सचेतना मां पश्येति विलपन्तं मुहुमुर्हुः ॥ 7 ॥

3.35.s:
manorame samuttiṣṭha mayā sārddhaṃ gṛhaṃ vraja ..
na kariṣyāmi samaraṃ bhṛguṇā saha bhāmini .. 8 ..
3.35.d:
मनोरमे समुत्तिष्ठ मया सार्द्धं गृहं व्रज ॥
न करिष्यामि समरं भृगुणा सह भामिनि ॥ 8 ॥

3.35.s:
manorame samuttiṣṭha śrīśailaṃ vraja sundari ..
tatra krīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā sārddhaṃ yathā purā .. 9 ..
3.35.d:
मनोरमे समुत्तिष्ठ श्रीशैलं व्रज सुन्दरि ॥
तत्र क्रीडां करिष्यामि त्वया सार्द्धं यथा पुरा ॥ 9 ॥

3.35.s:
manorame samuttiṣṭha vraja godāvarīṃ priye ..
jalakrīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā sārdhaṃ yathā purā .. 3.35.10 ..
3.35.d:
मनोरमे समुत्तिष्ठ व्रज गोदावरीं प्रिये ॥
जलक्रीडां करिष्यामि त्वया सार्धं यथा पुरा ॥ 3.35.10 ॥

3.35.s:
manorame samuttiṣṭha nandanaṃ vraja sundari ..
puṣpabhadrānadītīre vihariṣyāmi nirjane .. 11 ..
3.35.d:
मनोरमे समुत्तिष्ठ नन्दनं व्रज सुन्दरि ॥
पुष्पभद्रानदीतीरे विहरिष्यामि निर्जने ॥ 11 ॥

3.35.s:
manorame samuttiṣṭha malayaṃ vraja sundari ..
tvayā sārddhaṃ ramiṣye'haṃ tatra candanakānane .. 12 ..
3.35.d:
मनोरमे समुत्तिष्ठ मलयं व्रज सुन्दरि ॥
त्वया सार्द्धं रमिष्येऽहं तत्र चन्दनकानने ॥ 12 ॥

3.35.s:
śītena gandhayuktena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ..
bhramaradhvanisaṃyukte puṃskokila rutaśrite .. 13 ..
3.35.d:
शीतेन गन्धयुक्तेन वायुना सुरभीकृते ॥
भ्रमरध्वनिसंयुक्ते पुंस्कोकिल रुतश्रिते ॥ 13 ॥

3.35.s:
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumālepanaṃ kuru ..
candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ paśya māṃ sasmite sati .. 14 ..
3.35.d:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमालेपनं कुरु ॥
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं पश्य मां सस्मिते सति ॥ 14 ॥

3.35.s:
sudhātulyaṃ sumadhuraṃ vacanaṃ racaya priye ..
kuṭilabhrūvikāraṃ ca kathaṃ na kuruṣe'dhunā .. 15 ..
3.35.d:
सुधातुल्यं सुमधुरं वचनं रचय प्रिये ॥
कुटिलभ्रूविकारं च कथं न कुरुषेऽधुना ॥ 15 ॥

3.35.s:
nṛpasya rodanaṃ śrutvā vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ..
sthirībhava mahārāja kuruṣe rodanaṃ katham .. 16 ..
3.35.d:
नृपस्य रोदनं श्रुत्वा वाग्बभूवाशरीरिणी ॥
स्थिरीभव महाराज कुरुषे रोदनं कथम् ॥ 16 ॥

3.35.s:
tvaṃ mahājñānināṃ śreṣṭho dattātreyaprasādataḥ ..
jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ paśya śobhanam .. 17 ..
3.35.d:
त्वं महाज्ञानिनां श्रेष्ठो दत्तात्रेयप्रसादतः ॥
जलबुद्बुदवत्सर्वं संसारं पश्य शोभनम् ॥ 17 ॥

3.35.s:
kamalāṃśā ca sā sādhvī jagāma kamalālayam ..
tvameva gaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ raṇaṃ kṛtvā raṇājire .. 18 ..
3.35.d:
कमलांशा च सा साध्वी जगाम कमलालयम् ॥
त्वमेव गच्छ वैकुण्ठं रणं कृत्वा रणाजिरे ॥ 18 ॥

3.35.s:
ityeva vacanaṃ śrutvā jahau śokaṃ narādhipaḥ ..
tataścandanakāṣṭhena citāṃ divyāṃ cakāra ha .. 19 ..
3.35.d:
इत्येव वचनं श्रुत्वा जहौ शोकं नराधिपः ॥
ततश्चन्दनकाष्ठेन चितां दिव्यां चकार ह ॥ 19 ॥

3.35.s:
saṃskārāgniṃ kārayitvā putradvārā dadāha tām ..
nānāvidhāni ratnāni brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 3.35.20 ..
3.35.d:
संस्काराग्निं कारयित्वा पुत्रद्वारा ददाह ताम् ॥
नानाविधानि रत्नानि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥ 3.35.20 ॥

3.35.s:
nānāvidhāni dānāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca ..
manoramāyāḥ puṇyena brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ..21..
3.35.d:
नानाविधानि दानानि वस्त्राणि विविधानि च ॥
मनोरमायाः पुण्येन ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥21॥

3.35.s:
bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ śaśvaddīyatāṃ dīyatāmiti ..
śabdo babhūva sarvatra kārttavīryyāśrame mune ..22..
3.35.d:
भुज्यतां भुज्यतां शश्वद्दीयतां दीयतामिति ॥
शब्दो बभूव सर्वत्र कार्त्तवीर्य्याश्रमे मुने ॥22॥

3.35.s:
koṣeṣu svādhikāreṣu sthitaṃ yadyaddhanaṃ tadā ..
manoramāyāḥ puṇyena brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 23 ..
3.35.d:
कोषेषु स्वाधिकारेषु स्थितं यद्यद्धनं तदा ॥
मनोरमायाः पुण्येन ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥ 23 ॥

3.35.s:
rājā jagāma samaraṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ..
sārdhaṃ sainyasamūhaiśca vādyabhāṇḍairasaṃkhyakaiḥ ..24..
3.35.d:
राजा जगाम समरं हृदयेन विदूयता ॥
सार्धं सैन्यसमूहैश्च वाद्यभाण्डैरसंख्यकैः ॥24॥

3.35.s:
dadarśa maṅgalaṃ rājā puro vartmani vartmani ..
yayau tathāpi samaraṃ nājagāma gṛhaṃ punaḥ..25..
3.35.d:
ददर्श मङ्गलं राजा पुरो वर्त्मनि वर्त्मनि ॥
ययौ तथापि समरं नाजगाम गृहं पुनः॥25॥

3.35.s:
muktakeśīṃ chinnanāsāṃ rudatīṃ ca digambarām ..
kṛṣṇavastraparīdhānāmaparāṃ vidhavāmapi .. 26 ..
3.35.d:
मुक्तकेशीं छिन्ननासां रुदतीं च दिगम्बराम् ॥
कृष्णवस्त्रपरीधानामपरां विधवामपि ॥ 26 ॥

3.35.s:
mukhaduṣṭāṃ yoniduṣṭāṃ vyādhiyuktāṃ ca kuṭṭinīm ..
patiputravihīnāṃ ca ḍākinīṃ puṃścalī tathā .. 27 ..
3.35.d:
मुखदुष्टां योनिदुष्टां व्याधियुक्तां च कुट्टिनीम् ॥
पतिपुत्रविहीनां च डाकिनीं पुंश्चली तथा ॥ 27 ॥

3.35.s:
kumbhakāraṃ tailakāraṃ vyādhaṃ sarpopajīvinam ..
kucailamatirūkṣāṃgaṃ nagnaṃ kāṣāyavāsinam .. 28 ..
3.35.d:
कुम्भकारं तैलकारं व्याधं सर्पोपजीविनम् ॥
कुचैलमतिरूक्षांगं नग्नं काषायवासिनम् ॥ 28 ॥

3.35.s:
vasāvikrayiṇaṃ caiva kanyāvikrayiṇaṃ tathā ..
citādagdhaṃ śavaṃ bhasma nirvāṇāṅgārameva ca..29..
3.35.d:
वसाविक्रयिणं चैव कन्याविक्रयिणं तथा ॥
चितादग्धं शवं भस्म निर्वाणाङ्गारमेव च॥29॥
3.35.m:
"And why do you no longer make a knitting of your curved brows?"
Hearing the weeping of the king, a bodiless voice arose:
"Be calm, O great king! Why do you weep?
You are the foremost of the deeply wise, by the grace of Dattātreya.
Behold the entire world as fair, yet like a water bubble.
And that virtuous woman, a portion of Kamalā, has gone to the abode of Kamalā.
You too shall go to Vaikuṇṭha after fighting a battle on the battlefield."
Hearing this speech, the lord of men abandoned his grief.
Then indeed he prepared a divine pyre with sandalwood logs.
Having the funeral fire kindled through his son, he cremated her.
Joyfully he gave gems of various kinds to the brāhmaṇas.
Various gifts and diverse garments
he joyfully gave to the brāhmaṇas for the spiritual merit of Manoramā.
"Eat, eat constantly! Give, give!"—
such sound arose everywhere in Kārtavīrya's hermitage, O sage.
Whatever wealth remained in the treasuries under his authority at that time,
he joyfully gave to the brāhmaṇas for the spiritual merit of Manoramā.
With an aching heart the king set out for the battle,
together with hosts of troops and countless musical instruments.
The king saw [ill] omens ahead on path after path;
nevertheless, he went to the battle and did not return home again:
a woman with dishevelled hair, her nose cut off, weeping and sky-clad;
and another dressed in black garments, a widow;
a foul-mouthed woman, an adulteress, a sick woman, a procuress,
one devoid of husband and son, a ḍākinī, and an unchaste woman;
a potter, an oilman, a hunter, one who makes a living from snakes,
one in rags, one with very rough limbs, a naked man, an ascetic clad in ochre;
one who sells animal fat, one who sells his daughter,
a pyre-burned corpse, ashes, and extinguished charcoal;

3.35.s:
sarpakṣataṃ naraṃ sarpaṃ godhāṃ ca śaśakaṃ viṣam..
śrāddhapākaṃ ca piṇḍaṃ ca moṭakaṃ ca tilāṃstathā ..3.35.30..
3.35.d:
सर्पक्षतं नरं सर्पं गोधां च शशकं विषम्॥
श्राद्धपाकं च पिण्डं च मोटकं च तिलांस्तथा ॥3.35.30॥

3.35.s:
devalaṃ vṛṣavāhaṃ ca śūdraśrāddhānnabhojinam ..
śūdrānnapācakaṃ śūdrayājakaṃ grāmayājakamā.31..
3.35.d:
देवलं वृषवाहं च शूद्रश्राद्धान्नभोजिनम् ॥
शूद्रान्नपाचकं शूद्रयाजकं ग्रामयाजकमा.31॥

3.35.s:
kuśaputtalikāṃ caiva śavadāhanakāriṇam ..
śūnyakumbhaṃ bhagnakumbhaṃ tailaṃ lavaṇamasthi ca..32..
3.35.d:
कुशपुत्तलिकां चैव शवदाहनकारिणम् ॥
शून्यकुम्भं भग्नकुम्भं तैलं लवणमस्थि च॥32॥

3.35.s:
kārpāsaṃ kacchapaṃ cūrṇaṃ kukkuraṃ śabdakāriṇam ..
dakṣiṇe ca sṛgālaṃ ca kurvantaṃ bhairavaṃ ravam ..33..
3.35.d:
कार्पासं कच्छपं चूर्णं कुक्कुरं शब्दकारिणम् ॥
दक्षिणे च सृगालं च कुर्वन्तं भैरवं रवम् ॥33॥

3.35.s:
kapardakaṃ ca kṣauraṃ ca cchinnakeśaṃ nakhaṃ malam ..
kalahaṃ ca vilāpaṃ ca tathā tatkāriṇaṃ janam .. 34 ..
3.35.d:
कपर्दकं च क्षौरं च च्छिन्नकेशं नखं मलम् ॥
कलहं च विलापं च तथा तत्कारिणं जनम् ॥ 34 ॥

3.35.s: amaṅgalaṃ rudantaṃ ca rudantaṃ śokakāriṇam .. 35 ..
3.35.d: अमङ्गलं रुदन्तं च रुदन्तं शोककारिणम् ॥ 35 ॥

3.35.s:
mithyāsākṣya pradātāraṃ cauraṃ ca naraghātinam..
puṃścalīpatiputrau ca puṃścalyodanabhojinam .. 36 ..
3.35.d:
मिथ्यासाक्ष्य प्रदातारं चौरं च नरघातिनम्॥
पुंश्चलीपतिपुत्रौ च पुंश्चल्योदनभोजिनम् ॥ 36 ॥

3.35.s:
devatāguruviprāṇāṃ vastuvittāpahāriṇam ..
dattāpahāriṇaṃ dasyuṃ hiṃsakaṃ sūcakaṃ khalam .. 37 ..
3.35.d:
देवतागुरुविप्राणां वस्तुवित्तापहारिणम् ॥
दत्तापहारिणं दस्युं हिंसकं सूचकं खलम् ॥ 37 ॥

3.35.s:
pitṛmātṛviraktaṃ ca dvijāśvatthavighātinam ..
satyaghnaṃ ca kṛtaghnaṃ ca sthāpyasyāpyapahāriṇam .. 38 ..
3.35.d:
पितृमातृविरक्तं च द्विजाश्वत्थविघातिनम् ॥
सत्यघ्नं च कृतघ्नं च स्थाप्यस्याप्यपहारिणम् ॥ 38 ॥

3.35.s:
vipramitradrohamevaṃ kṣataṃ viśvāsaghātakam ..
gurudevadvijānāṃ ca nindakaṃ svāṃgaghātakam .. 39 ..
3.35.d:
विप्रमित्रद्रोहमेवं क्षतं विश्वासघातकम् ॥
गुरुदेवद्विजानां च निन्दकं स्वांगघातकम् ॥ 39 ॥

3.35.s:
jīvānāṃ ghātakaṃ caiva svāṃgahīnaṃ ca nirdayam..
vratopavāsahīnaṃ ca dīkṣāhīnaṃ napuṃsakam ..3.35.40..
3.35.d:
जीवानां घातकं चैव स्वांगहीनं च निर्दयम्॥
व्रतोपवासहीनं च दीक्षाहीनं नपुंसकम् ॥3.35.40॥

3.35.s:
galitavyādhigātraṃ ca kāṇaṃ badhirameva ca ..
pulkasaṃ chinnaliṅgaṃ ca surāmattaṃ surāṃ tathā ..41..
3.35.d:
गलितव्याधिगात्रं च काणं बधिरमेव च ॥
पुल्कसं छिन्नलिङ्गं च सुरामत्तं सुरां तथा ॥41॥

3.35.s:
kṣiptaṃ vamantaṃ rudhiraṃ mahiṣaṃ gardabhaṃ tathā ..
mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ rūkṣiṇaṃ nṛkapālakam ..42..
3.35.d:
क्षिप्तं वमन्तं रुधिरं महिषं गर्दभं तथा ॥
मूत्रं पुरीषं श्लेष्माणं रूक्षिणं नृकपालकम् ॥42॥

3.35.s:
caṇḍavātaṃ raktavṛṣṭiṃ vādyaṃ vai vṛkṣapātanam ..
vṛkaṃ ca sūkaraṃ gṛdhraṃ śyenaṃ kaṅkaṃ ca bhallukam..43..
3.35.d:
चण्डवातं रक्तवृष्टिं वाद्यं वै वृक्षपातनम् ॥
वृकं च सूकरं गृध्रं श्येनं कङ्कं च भल्लुकम्॥43॥

3.35.s: pāśaṃ ca śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ ca vāyasaṃ gandhakaṃ tathā..44..
3.35.d: पाशं च शुष्ककाष्ठं च वायसं गन्धकं तथा॥44॥

3.35.s:
pratigrāhibrāhmaṇaṃ ca tantramantropajīvinam..
vaidyaṃ ca raktapuṣpaṃ cāpyauṣadhaṃ tuṣameva ca..45..
3.35.d:
प्रतिग्राहिब्राह्मणं च तन्त्रमन्त्रोपजीविनम्॥
वैद्यं च रक्तपुष्पं चाप्यौषधं तुषमेव च॥45॥
3.35.m:
a physician, a red flower, medicine, and chaff;
bad news, news of death, a harsh curse of a brāhmaṇa,
a foul-smelling wind, and an ominous sound the king saw on the path.
His mind became depressed, his vital breaths were incessantly agitated,
and trembling in his left limbs and torpor of the body occurred to the king.
Even so, undaunted, the king surveyed the battleground;
accompanied by his entire army, he entered the arena of war.
Quickly descending from his chariot and seeing Bhṛgu's descendant before him,
he prostrated himself on the ground like a staff with devotion, together with the foremost kings.
Rāma bestowed the desired blessing: "Go to heaven!"
That became acceptable to them; the blessings of a brāhmaṇa cannot be transgressed.
Having bowed to Bhṛgu's descendant, the royal sovereign immediately, along with the foremost kings,
quickly mounted his chariot, equipped with various weapons.
He had musical instruments of various types sounded at once,
such as the kettledrum and the muraja-drum, and he gave wealth to the brāhmaṇas.
Rāma, the foremost of the knowers of the Veda, spoke to the king of kings
in the assembly of royal sovereigns words beneficial, true, and the essence of right conduct.
Paraśurāma said:
"Listen, O king of kings, most righteous one, born in the lunar dynasty!
You are a disciple of the wise Dattātreya, a portion of Viṣṇu.
You yourself are learned, having heard the Vedas from the mouth of a knower of the Veda;
why then this wickedness now, this harm done to good people?
Why did you previously, out of greed, slay a harmless brāhmaṇa?
Tormented by grief, his chaste wife accompanied her husband.
What will become of you hereafter, O king, from the slaying of these two?
The whole world is truly unreal, like water on a lotus leaf.
Good fame and bad fame remain only as a tale;
or what mockery is worse than bad fame for good people, alas!
Where has the Kapilā cow gone? Where are you? Where is the dispute? Whence the sage?

3.35.s:
kuvārttāṃ mṛtavārtāṃ ca vipraśāpaṃ ca dāruṇam..
durgandhivātaṃ duśśabdaṃ rājā'paśyatsa vartmani .. 46 ..
3.35.d:
कुवार्त्तां मृतवार्तां च विप्रशापं च दारुणम्॥
दुर्गन्धिवातं दुश्शब्दं राजाऽपश्यत्स वर्त्मनि ॥ 46 ॥

3.35.s:
manaśca kutsitaṃ prāṇāḥ kṣubhitāśca nirantaram..
vāmāṃgaspandanaṃ dehajāḍyaṃ rājño babhūva ha .. 47 ..
3.35.d:
मनश्च कुत्सितं प्राणाः क्षुभिताश्च निरन्तरम्॥
वामांगस्पन्दनं देहजाड्यं राज्ञो बभूव ह ॥ 47 ॥

3.35.s:
tathā'pi rājā niśśaṅko dadarśa samarāṅgaṇam ..
sarvasainyasamāyuktaḥ praviveśa raṇājiram .. 48 ..
3.35.d:
तथाऽपि राजा निश्शङ्को ददर्श समराङ्गणम् ॥
